strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.title: 杯酒释兵权
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.subtitle: 宋太祖
strings.vo.01: 宋朝立国第二年。殿前司、侍卫司的兵权，仍握在当年陈桥拥立的几位宿将手中。
strings.vo.02: 赵普几次进言：这些人不是会造反，只怕他们麾下的人贪图富贵，有一天也把黄袍披到他们身上。
strings.vo.03: 太祖于是在晚朝后留下石守信等人饮酒。
strings.vo.04: 酒到半酣，他说：我做天子，倒不如做节度使快乐，终夜不敢安枕。
strings.vo.05: 诸将惶恐，叩头问计。太祖说：人生如白驹过隙——
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.fork.prompt: 杯酒释兵权——依《续资治通鉴长编》直书，还是听演义《宋史演义》？
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.pick.canon: 正史 · 《续资治通鉴长编》所载（本于宋人笔记）
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.canon.intro: 建隆二年七月，晚朝刚散。太祖留下了石守信、王审琦这些陈桥旧人，说今夜要喝几杯。
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.end.canon: 次日，石守信等皆称疾，请解兵权。太祖一一允准，赏赐甚厚，令出镇地方。此后禁军分属三衙，宋代由此走向以文制武。
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.legend.disclaimer: 以下按蔡东藩《宋史演义》第七回改编。演义大体依《长编》，对话铺陈为小说笔墨。今人对此事细节亦有讨论，以为宋人记载或有渲染。
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.legend.intro: 演义写太祖酒后长叹，诸将跪请其故，太祖才说出那番“多积金银、歌儿舞女”的劝告，诸将拜谢而退。
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.end.legend: 演义与《长编》同归一处：诸将释兵，富贵终老。
strings.scene.beisong.beijiu.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若诸将不肯释兵（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 宋朝立国第二年。殿前司、侍卫司的兵权，仍握在当年陈桥拥立的几位宿将手中。
赵普几次进言：这些人不是会造反，只怕他们麾下的人贪图富贵，有一天也把黄袍披到他们身上。
太祖于是在晚朝后留下石守信等人饮酒。
酒到半酣，他说：我做天子，倒不如做节度使快乐，终夜不敢安枕。
诸将惶恐，叩头问计。太祖说：人生如白驹过隙——
次日，石守信等皆称疾，请解兵权。太祖一一允准，赏赐甚厚，令出镇地方。此后禁军分属三衙，宋代由此走向以文制武。
人生如白驹之过隙

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：月；中景：殿柱、城墙雉堞、屋檐｜动作：汴京宫城，晚朝之后｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：片名「杯酒释兵权」竖排书法与朱印「杯酒」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋朝立国第二年。殿前司、侍卫司的兵权，仍握在当年陈桥拥立的几位宿将手中。」
镜头 2（10–21 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、卷轴；主体：赵普、赵匡胤｜动作：赵普对太祖说：典禁兵者不可不虑｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「赵普几次进言：这些人不是会造反，只怕他们麾下的人贪图富贵，有一天也把黄袍披到他们身上。」
镜头 3（21–27 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：石守信、众人｜动作：宫中设宴，宿将列坐｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：引文「人生如白驹之过隙」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「太祖于是在晚朝后留下石守信等人饮酒。」
镜头 4（27–35 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：月；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：赵匡胤｜动作：酒酣，太祖屏退左右｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染｜声音：环境：寂静室内｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「酒到半酣，他说：我做天子，倒不如做节度使快乐，终夜不敢安枕。」
镜头 5（35–41 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：卷轴、解兵；主体：石守信｜动作：次日，诸将上表称疾｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「诸将惶恐，叩头问计。太祖说：人生如白驹过隙——」
镜头 6（41–54 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：石守信｜动作：正史结局：次日，石守信等皆称疾，请解兵权。太祖一一允准，赏赐甚厚，令出镇地方。此后禁军分属三衙，宋代由此走向以文制武。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「次日，石守信等皆称疾，请解兵权。太祖一一允准，赏赐甚厚，令出镇地方。此后禁军分属三衙，宋代由此走向以文制武。」
镜头 7（54–60 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「人生如白驹之过隙」，下署《涑水记闻·卷一》；右下角朱印「杯酒」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「人生如白驹之过隙」

声音：背景乐：笛子，清丽，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：宫殿回响、寂静室内；音效：脚步声、衣袂摩挲、低语、笔落；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「杯酒释兵权」、副题「宋太祖」、朱印「杯酒」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「人生如白驹之过隙」——《涑水记闻·卷一》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · Releasing Military Power over Wine: Emperor Taizu of Song (「杯酒释兵权」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 60 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 961 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Zhao Kuangyin (赵匡胤) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhao Pu (赵普) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Shi Shouxin (石守信) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Shenqi (王审琦) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Gao Huaide (高怀德) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, crenellated city wall, palace eaves | Action: The Bianjing palace after evening court | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「杯酒释兵权」 with vermilion seal 「杯酒」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋朝立国第二年。殿前司、侍卫司的兵权，仍握在当年陈桥拥立的几位宿将手中。」
Shot 2 (10–21 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, scroll; subject: Zhao Pu, Zhao Kuangyin | Action: Zhao Pu warns: the guard commanders must be considered | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「赵普几次进言：这些人不是会造反，只怕他们麾下的人贪图富贵，有一天也把黄袍披到他们身上。」
Shot 3 (21–27 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Shi Shouxin, crowd | Action: A palace banquet with veteran generals seated in rows | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「人生如白驹之过隙」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「太祖于是在晚朝后留下石守信等人饮酒。」
Shot 4 (27–35 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhao Kuangyin | Action: Deep in the wine, Taizu sends the attendants away | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「酒到半酣，他说：我做天子，倒不如做节度使快乐，终夜不敢安枕。」
Shot 5 (35–41 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: scroll, 解兵; subject: Shi Shouxin | Action: Next day the generals plead illness | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸将惶恐，叩头问计。太祖说：人生如白驹过隙——」
Shot 6 (41–54 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Shi Shouxin | Action: Canonical outcome: The generals resign their commands and receive rich rewards; the guards are split into three commands and Song civil rule over the military begins. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「次日，石守信等皆称疾，请解兵权。太祖一一允准，赏赐甚厚，令出镇地方。此后禁军分属三衙，宋代由此走向以文制武。」
Shot 7 (54–60 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「人生如白驹之过隙」 signed 《涑水记闻·卷一》; vermilion seal 「杯酒」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「人生如白驹之过隙」

Sound: Music: dizi flute, clear and lyrical, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps, rustling silk, murmuring, brush dropped; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「杯酒释兵权」, subtitle 「宋太祖」 and vermilion seal 「杯酒」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「人生如白驹之过隙」 — 《涑水记闻·卷一》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.title: 烛影斧声
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.subtitle: 太祖之死
strings.vo.01: 宋太祖赵匡胤和弟弟赵光义的母亲杜太后临终前，嘱咐太祖将来传位给弟弟。宰相赵普写下誓书，藏在金匮里，这就是后世所说的金匮之盟。
strings.vo.02: 开宝九年十月，一个下雪的夜晚，太祖召晋王赵光义入宫饮酒。
strings.vo.03: 当天夜里，太祖在万岁殿驾崩，年五十岁。
strings.vo.04: 宋皇后命内侍王继恩去召太祖的儿子赵德芳，王继恩却径直去了晋王府。
strings.vo.05: 皇后看见进来的是晋王，大吃一惊，随即改口——
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.fork.prompt: 烛影斧声——依《宋史》直书，还是听笔记《续湘山野录》？
strings.anchor.jingui: 杜太后临终，命太祖传位于弟，赵普书为誓书，藏于金匮
strings.anchor.dezhao: 太祖之子赵德昭被太宗责问后自刎
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.canon.intro: 一个下雪的夜晚，皇帝召弟弟进宫喝酒。第二天天亮，弟弟成了皇帝。
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.end.canon: 赵光义即位，就是宋太宗，当年就改元太平兴国。三年后，太祖的儿子赵德昭随太宗北征，因为劝太宗赏赐将士被责问，回去后自刎而死。又过了两年，赵德芳也病死了。
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.legend.disclaimer: 以下取北宋僧人文莹《续湘山野录》的记载：说当晚宫人在外面远远看见烛影下晋王时而离席，似有退避之状，太祖用柱斧戳雪，说“好做，好做”。此书写于事后数十年，“烛影斧声”从此成为千古疑案，太宗是否弑兄并无定论。
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.legend.intro: 文莹写道，那天夜里，宫人远远看见殿里的烛影下，晋王时时离开座位，像是在躲避什么。
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.end.legend: 文莹说，太祖戳雪时说的是“好做，好做”。这四个字是劝勉，还是别的什么，一千年来没有人能说清楚。
strings.scene.beisong.zhuying.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若王继恩去召德芳（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 宋太祖赵匡胤和弟弟赵光义的母亲杜太后临终前，嘱咐太祖将来传位给弟弟。宰相赵普写下誓书，藏在金匮里，这就是后世所说的金匮之盟。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–15 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、城墙雉堞、屋檐；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：开封城下了一夜的雪，宫城的屋檐上积满了白｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：低风；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：片名「烛影斧声」竖排书法与朱印「烛影」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋太祖赵匡胤和弟弟赵光义的母亲杜太后临终前，嘱咐太祖将来传位给弟弟。宰相赵普写下誓书，藏在金匮里，这就是后世所说的金匮之盟。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, crenellated city wall, palace eaves; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: Snow has fallen all night on Kaifeng and the palace eaves are piled with white | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「烛影斧声」 with vermilion seal 「烛影」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋太祖赵匡胤和弟弟赵光义的母亲杜太后临终前，嘱咐太祖将来传位给弟弟。宰相赵普写下誓书，藏在金匮里，这就是后世所说的金匮之盟。」

shots.vo: 开宝九年十月，一个下雪的夜晚，太祖召晋王赵光义入宫饮酒。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（15–23 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：赵匡胤、赵光义、火｜动作：万岁殿里，兄弟二人对饮，窗纸上映着两个人影｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：碰杯｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「开宝九年十月，一个下雪的夜晚，太祖召晋王赵光义入宫饮酒。」

narration: 宋太祖赵匡胤和弟弟赵光义的母亲杜太后临终前，嘱咐太祖将来传位给弟弟。宰相赵普写下誓书，藏在金匮里，这就是后世所说的金匮之盟。
开宝九年十月，一个下雪的夜晚，太祖召晋王赵光义入宫饮酒。
当天夜里，太祖在万岁殿驾崩，年五十岁。
宋皇后命内侍王继恩去召太祖的儿子赵德芳，王继恩却径直去了晋王府。
皇后看见进来的是晋王，大吃一惊，随即改口——
赵光义即位，就是宋太宗，当年就改元太平兴国。三年后，太祖的儿子赵德昭随太宗北征，因为劝太宗赏赐将士被责问，回去后自刎而死。
吾母子之命，皆托官家。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

镜头 6（44–58 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：宋皇后、赵光义｜动作：正史结局：赵光义即位，就是宋太宗，当年就改元太平兴国。三年后，太祖的儿子赵德昭随太宗北征，因为劝太宗赏赐将士被责问，回去后自刎而死。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「赵光义即位，就是宋太宗，当年就改元太平兴国。三年后，太祖的儿子赵德昭随太宗北征，因为劝太宗赏赐将士被责问，回去后自刎而死。」
镜头 7（58–64 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「吾母子之命，皆托官家。」，下署《涑水记闻·卷一》；右下角朱印「烛影」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「吾母子之命，皆托官家。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：低风、寂静室内、宫殿回响；音效：静默、碰杯、刀鸣、脚步声、gong；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「烛影斧声」、副题「太祖之死」、朱印「烛影」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「吾母子之命，皆托官家。」——《涑水记闻·卷一》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · Candle Shadows and the Sound of an Axe: The Death of Taizu (「烛影斧声」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 64 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 976 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Zhao Kuangyin (赵匡胤) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhao Guangyi (赵光义) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Empress Song (宋皇后) — commoner, Song; women in beizi over a breast-wrap, floral crown or high chignon; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Jien (王继恩) — commoner, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, crenellated city wall, palace eaves; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: Snow has fallen all night on Kaifeng and the palace eaves are piled with white | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「烛影斧声」 with vermilion seal 「烛影」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋太祖赵匡胤和弟弟赵光义的母亲杜太后临终前，嘱咐太祖将来传位给弟弟。宰相赵普写下誓书，藏在金匮里，这就是后世所说的金匮之盟。」
Shot 2 (15–23 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhao Kuangyin, Zhao Guangyi, fire (splashed ink) | Action: In the Wansui Hall two brothers drink together, their shadows cast on the paper window | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: clinking cups | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「开宝九年十月，一个下雪的夜晚，太祖召晋王赵光义入宫饮酒。」
Shot 3 (23–29 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhao Kuangyin; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: The candle shadows waver and a jade-handled axe strikes into the snow | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「吾母子之命，皆托官家。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「当天夜里，太祖在万岁殿驾崩，年五十岁。」
Shot 4 (29–38 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: Wang Jien; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: Near dawn a eunuch leaves the palace through the snow but does not go to the prince's mansion | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋皇后命内侍王继恩去召太祖的儿子赵德芳，王继恩却径直去了晋王府。」
Shot 5 (38–44 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Empress Song, Zhao Guangyi; dry-brush calligraphy 「烛影」 | Action: Seeing that the man entering is the Prince of Jin, the empress falters and then speaks | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: ringing blade, gong | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「皇后看见进来的是晋王，大吃一惊，随即改口——」
Shot 6 (44–58 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Empress Song, Zhao Guangyi | Action: Canonical outcome: Zhao Guangyi takes the throne as Emperor Taizong and changes the era that same year; three years later Taizu's son Dezhao takes his own life after a rebuke, and two years after that Defang dies of illness. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「赵光义即位，就是宋太宗，当年就改元太平兴国。三年后，太祖的儿子赵德昭随太宗北征，因为劝太宗赏赐将士被责问，回去后自刎而死。」
Shot 7 (58–64 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「吾母子之命，皆托官家。」 signed 《涑水记闻·卷一》; vermilion seal 「烛影」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「吾母子之命，皆托官家。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: low wind, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb; SFX: silence, clinking cups, ringing blade, footsteps, gong; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「烛影斧声」, subtitle 「太祖之死」 and vermilion seal 「烛影」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「吾母子之命，皆托官家。」 — 《涑水记闻·卷一》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.beisong.yangye.title: 陈家谷
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.subtitle: 杨业
strings.vo.01: 雍熙三年，宋军三路北伐。东路曹彬在岐沟关大败，全局崩溃。
strings.vo.02: 西路的潘美、杨业奉诏，护送寰、朔、云、应四州百姓内迁。辽军十余万已到。
strings.vo.03: 杨业主张避敌锋芒，从小路接应百姓。监军王侁说：君侯素号无敌，今逗挠不战，得非有他志乎？
strings.vo.04: 杨业知道此去必败，临行指着陈家谷口说：请诸君在此布置步兵强弩，为我左右接应。
strings.vo.05: 他从中午战到日暮，退到谷口，却一个人也没有——
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.quote: 上遇我厚，期讨贼捍边以报，而反为奸臣所迫，致王师败绩，何面目求活于虏中
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.fork.prompt: 陈家谷——依《宋史》直书，还是听演义「杨家将」？
strings.anchor.yongxi: 雍熙北伐，潘美杨业出雁门
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.canon.intro: 朔州城外，辽军旌旗已经望得见了。四州的百姓扶老携幼，正等着宋军护送南撤。
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.end.canon: 谷口无援。杨业身被数十创，马重伤，被辽军所擒，子延玉、部将王贵等皆战死。杨业绝食三日而死。朝廷削潘美三任，王侁除名配金州。
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.legend.disclaimer: 以下取明代小说《杨家府世代忠勇通俗演义》与蔡东藩《宋史演义》第十七回。小说写杨业在李陵碑前撞碑而死，并有潘仁美构陷、七子从征等情节，正史只载杨业不食而死，七子之名多为附会。
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.legend.intro: 小说里，杨业被困两狼山，望见道旁一座石碑，上刻“李陵碑”三字。他想起李陵降胡的旧事，长叹一声。
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.end.legend: 碑前的撞死与正史的绝食，是同一种不肯偷生。杨家将的故事从此在戏台上流传。
strings.scene.beisong.yangye.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若陈家谷口伏兵未撤（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 雍熙三年（986 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 986 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

shots.vo: 雍熙三年，宋军三路北伐。东路曹彬在岐沟关大败，全局崩溃。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、关门；主体：盾墙｜动作：雁门关外，寰朔云应四州｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：草原风｜屏幕文字：片名「陈家谷」竖排书法与朱印「杨业」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「雍熙三年，宋军三路北伐。东路曹彬在岐沟关大败，全局崩溃。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, gate; subject: shield wall | Action: Beyond Yanmen Pass, the four prefectures of Huan, Shuo, Yun and Ying | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「陈家谷」 with vermilion seal 「杨业」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「雍熙三年，宋军三路北伐。东路曹彬在岐沟关大败，全局崩溃。」

shots.vo: 西路的潘美、杨业奉诏，护送寰、朔、云、应四州百姓内迁。辽军十余万已到。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：地图卷、营帐；主体：潘美｜动作：东路曹彬败于岐沟关，诏西路护民内迁｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「西路的潘美、杨业奉诏，护送寰、朔、云、应四州百姓内迁。辽军十余万已到。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: map scroll, army tents; subject: Pan Mei | Action: Cao Bin is beaten at Qigou; the western army is ordered to escort civilians south | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「西路的潘美、杨业奉诏，护送寰、朔、云、应四州百姓内迁。辽军十余万已到。」

shots.vo: 杨业主张避敌锋芒，从小路接应百姓。监军王侁说：君侯素号无敌，今逗挠不战，得非有他志乎？

narration: 雍熙三年，宋军三路北伐。东路曹彬在岐沟关大败，全局崩溃。
西路的潘美、杨业奉诏，护送寰、朔、云、应四州百姓内迁。辽军十余万已到。
杨业主张避敌锋芒，从小路接应百姓。监军王侁说：君侯素号无敌，今逗挠不战，得非有他志乎？
杨业知道此去必败，临行指着陈家谷口说：请诸君在此布置步兵强弩，为我左右接应。
他从中午战到日暮，退到谷口，却一个人也没有——
谷口无援。杨业身被数十创，马重伤，被辽军所擒，子延玉、部将王贵等皆战死。杨业绝食三日而死。朝廷削潘美三任，王侁除名配金州。
上遇我厚，期讨贼捍边以报，而反为奸臣所迫，致王师败绩，何面目求活于虏中

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

镜头 6（45–59 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：杨业｜动作：正史结局：谷口无援。杨业身被数十创，马重伤，被辽军所擒，子延玉、部将王贵等皆战死。杨业绝食三日而死。朝廷削潘美三任，王侁除名配金州。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「谷口无援。杨业身被数十创，马重伤，被辽军所擒，子延玉、部将王贵等皆战死。杨业绝食三日而死。朝廷削潘美三任，王侁除名配金州。」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、军营鼓声、旷野风声、远处厮杀声；音效：竹简翻动、低语、号角、喊杀；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「陈家谷」、副题「杨业」、朱印「杨业」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「上遇我厚，期讨贼捍边以报，而反为奸臣所迫，致王师败绩，何面目求活于虏中」——《宋史·杨业传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · Chenjiagu: Yang Ye (「陈家谷」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 65 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 986 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Yang Ye (杨业) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Pan Mei (潘美) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Shen (王侁) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Wenyu (刘文裕) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yang Yanyu (杨延玉) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yelü Xiezhen (耶律斜轸) — general, Liao (Khitan); Khitan dress: shaved crown, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, leather boots; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, gate; subject: shield wall | Action: Beyond Yanmen Pass, the four prefectures of Huan, Shuo, Yun and Ying | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「陈家谷」 with vermilion seal 「杨业」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「雍熙三年，宋军三路北伐。东路曹彬在岐沟关大败，全局崩溃。」
Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: map scroll, army tents; subject: Pan Mei | Action: Cao Bin is beaten at Qigou; the western army is ordered to escort civilians south | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「西路的潘美、杨业奉诏，护送寰、朔、云、应四州百姓内迁。辽军十余万已到。」
Shot 3 (17–28 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Wang Shen, Yang Ye | Action: Wang Shen taunts: you are called the Invincible | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「上遇我厚，期讨贼捍边以报，而反为奸臣所迫，致王师败绩，何面目求活于虏中」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「杨业主张避敌锋芒，从小路接应百姓。监军王侁说：君侯素号无敌，今逗挠不战，得非有他志乎？」
Shot 4 (28–38 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Yang Ye, bow | Action: Yang Ye points to Chenjiagu: set crossbows here to support me | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「杨业知道此去必败，临行指着陈家谷口说：请诸君在此布置步兵强弩，为我左右接应。」
Shot 5 (38–45 s, 7 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: Yang Ye, cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「陈家谷」 | Action: At Langya village he suffers dozens of wounds | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; ink spatters where hooves strike; pale ink smoke drifting sideways; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他从中午战到日暮，退到谷口，却一个人也没有——」
Shot 6 (45–59 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Yang Ye | Action: Canonical outcome: No help comes; Yang Ye is captured and starves himself to death, and the officers who abandoned him are punished. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「谷口无援。杨业身被数十创，马重伤，被辽军所擒，子延玉、部将王贵等皆战死。杨业绝食三日而死。朝廷削潘美三任，王侁除名配金州。」
Shot 7 (59–65 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「上遇我厚，期讨贼捍边以报，而反为奸臣所迫，致王师败绩，何面目求活于虏中」 signed 《宋史·杨业传》; vermilion seal 「杨业」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「上遇我厚，期讨贼捍边以报，而反为奸臣所迫，致王师败绩，何面目求活于虏中」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, camp drums, wind over open plains, distant battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, murmuring, horn, war cries; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「陈家谷」, subtitle 「杨业」 and vermilion seal 「杨业」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「上遇我厚，期讨贼捍边以报，而反为奸臣所迫，致王师败绩，何面目求活于虏中」 — 《宋史·杨业传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.title: 澶渊之盟
strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.subtitle: 景德元年
strings.vo.01: 景德元年秋，辽萧太后与圣宗率大军南下，深入宋境。
strings.vo.02: 朝中有人主张南迁金陵，有人主张入蜀。宰相寇准力主亲征。
strings.vo.03: 真宗行至澶州南城，犹豫不前。寇准力请渡河。
strings.vo.04: 帝登北城门楼，诸军望见御盖，踊跃呼万岁，声闻数十里。
strings.vo.05: 辽统军萧挞凛出阵视察地形——
strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.fork.prompt: 澶渊之盟——依《宋史》直书，还是听演义「杨家将」？
strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.canon.intro: 辽军已到澶州城北。朝中有人劝真宗幸金陵，有人劝幸成都。寇准说：谁为陛下画此策者，罪可斩也。
strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.end.canon: 宋辽订立澶渊之盟：宋岁给辽银十万两、绢二十万匹，两国约为兄弟。此后百余年间，宋辽之间大体无大战。
strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自明代小说《杨家府演义》等杨家将故事，多为小说与戏曲虚构，与史实出入很大。
strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.legend.intro: 杨家将故事把这一时期写成杨家父子与辽国的连年苦战：杨六郎镇守三关，佘太君挂帅，萧太后摆下天门阵。
strings.scene.beisong.chanyuan.end.legend: 天门阵破，故事里杨家威名远扬。小说的硝烟散去，正史依旧：澶渊之盟。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 景德元年秋，辽萧太后与圣宗率大军南下，深入宋境。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–7 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞｜动作：黄河两岸，澶州南北二城｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜屏幕文字：片名「澶渊之盟」竖排书法与朱印「澶渊」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「景德元年秋，辽萧太后与圣宗率大军南下，深入宋境。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall | Action: The two towns of Chanzhou on either bank of the Yellow River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; scorched-ink outline of battlements; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「澶渊之盟」 with vermilion seal 「澶渊」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「景德元年秋，辽萧太后与圣宗率大军南下，深入宋境。」

shots.vo: 朝中有人主张南迁金陵，有人主张入蜀。宰相寇准力主亲征。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（7–15 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：萧太后、骑兵、旌旗｜动作：辽军大举南下｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「朝中有人主张南迁金陵，有人主张入蜀。宰相寇准力主亲征。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (7–15 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Empress Dowager Xiao, cavalry, banners | Action: The Liao army sweeps south | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「朝中有人主张南迁金陵，有人主张入蜀。宰相寇准力主亲征。」

shots.vo: 真宗行至澶州南城，犹豫不前。寇准力请渡河。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（15–21 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：王钦若、寇准｜动作：朝堂：有人主张南迁｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「真宗行至澶州南城，犹豫不前。寇准力请渡河。」

narration: 景德元年秋，辽萧太后与圣宗率大军南下，深入宋境。
朝中有人主张南迁金陵，有人主张入蜀。宰相寇准力主亲征。
真宗行至澶州南城，犹豫不前。寇准力请渡河。
帝登北城门楼，诸军望见御盖，踊跃呼万岁，声闻数十里。
辽统军萧挞凛出阵视察地形——
宋辽订立澶渊之盟：宋岁给辽银十万两、绢二十万匹，两国约为兄弟。此后百余年间，宋辽之间大体无大战。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · The Treaty of Chanyuan (「澶渊之盟」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 52 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1004 CE–1005 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Song Zhenzong (宋真宗) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Kou Zhun (寇准) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.title: 狸猫换太子
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.subtitle: 刘太后与李宸妃
strings.vo.01: 宋真宗的刘皇后没有儿子。宫人李氏生下皇子后，刘皇后把孩子抱来当作自己的儿子抚养。宫中上下，没有人敢告诉这个孩子他的生母是谁。
strings.vo.02: 真宗死后，十三岁的仁宗即位，刘太后垂帘听政十一年。
strings.vo.03: 李氏一直默默地生活在宫人之中，被派去守护真宗的陵墓，从不敢自认是皇帝的母亲。
strings.vo.04: 明道元年，李氏病死，刘太后想草草安葬。宰相吕夷简劝她说：如果您还想保全刘氏一族，丧礼就应该从厚。太后终于同意用一品礼殓葬，棺里灌上水银。
strings.vo.05: 第二年刘太后去世，仁宗的叔父燕王告诉他：陛下是李宸妃所生，她死于非命。仁宗号啕痛哭，好几天不上朝，亲自去洪福院开棺——
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.quote: 陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.fork.prompt: 狸猫换太子——依《宋史》直书，还是听小说《三侠五义》？
strings.anchor.shengzi: 宫人李氏生皇子赵受益，刘皇后取为己子
strings.anchor.kaiguan: 刘太后崩，仁宗始知生母，开棺验视
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.canon.intro: 一个皇帝长到二十三岁，才知道自己的母亲是谁。那时，她已经去世一年了。
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.end.canon: 仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！他对刘氏一族反而更加优厚，追尊李宸妃为皇太后，谥庄懿，庆历年间改谥章懿。
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.legend.disclaimer: 以下取清代石玉昆说书《三侠五义》的情节：说刘妃与太监郭槐合谋，用一只剥了皮的狸猫换走李妃刚生下的太子，李妃被打入冷宫，流落民间，后来由包公为她申冤。属小说虚构；历史上包拯与此事无关，李氏也从未流落民间。
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.legend.intro: 三侠五义里说，李妃生下太子的那天夜里，有人把一只剥了皮的狸猫放进了襁褓。
strings.scene.beisong.liuhou.end.legend: 小说里，包公为李太后申了冤，仁宗把母亲迎回了宫中。“狸猫换太子”从此成了戏台上最有名的宫廷故事之一。

画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 水流笔迹。
第 2 行：4. 墨滴下坠；5. 火（过场笔画所绘）；6. 烟（过场笔画所绘）。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。
artPrompts.negative: 文字, 书法, 题字, 印章, 边框, 网格线, 底纹, 纸纹, 背景色, 白底, 阴影, 倒影, 水印, 写实照片, 3D 渲染, 厚涂, 现代器物, 现代服饰, 多余肢体, 五官崩坏, 全彩, 多色, 粉彩, 马卡龙色, Q 版, 萌系, 大头娃娃, 精细繁复纹理, 大量渐变的 CG 质感, 金色高光, 蒸汽朋克机械, 细密界画线条, 细密皴纹, 复杂五官, 日本刀（武士刀）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 宋仁宗明道元年（1032 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1032 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

characters.name: 刘娥
characters.zh: 刘娥（宋·章献明肃皇后，仁宗嫡母）：女子褙子与抹胸，花冠或高髻；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；取李氏之子为己子，垂帘听政十一年
characters.en: Liu E (刘娥) — ruler, Song; women in beizi over a breast-wrap, floral crown or high chignon; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 李宸妃
characters.zh: 李宸妃（宋·仁宗生母）：女子褙子与抹胸，花冠或高髻；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；终身不敢自认，死后进位宸妃
characters.en: Li Chenfei (李宸妃) — commoner, Song; women in beizi over a breast-wrap, floral crown or high chignon; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 宋仁宗
characters.zh: 宋仁宗（宋·赵祯）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；太后崩后才知生母
characters.en: Song Renzong (宋仁宗) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 吕夷简
characters.zh: 吕夷简（宋·宰相）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；劝太后以厚礼殓葬李宸妃，以水银实棺
characters.en: Lü Yijian (吕夷简) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 宋真宗的刘皇后没有儿子。宫人李氏生下皇子后，刘皇后把孩子抱来当作自己的儿子抚养。宫中上下，没有人敢告诉这个孩子他的生母是谁。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–15 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：李宸妃、众人｜动作：后宫的一间偏殿里，一个宫女抱着刚出生的孩子，被皇后的人接走了｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：片名「狸猫换太子」竖排书法与朱印「宸妃」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋真宗的刘皇后没有儿子。宫人李氏生下皇子后，刘皇后把孩子抱来当作自己的儿子抚养。宫中上下，没有人敢告诉这个孩子他的生母是谁。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Li Chenfei, crowd | Action: In a side hall of the inner palace a maid holding a newborn hands the child to the empress's people | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「狸猫换太子」 with vermilion seal 「宸妃」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋真宗的刘皇后没有儿子。宫人李氏生下皇子后，刘皇后把孩子抱来当作自己的儿子抚养。宫中上下，没有人敢告诉这个孩子他的生母是谁。」

shots.vo: 真宗死后，十三岁的仁宗即位，刘太后垂帘听政十一年。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（15–22 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：刘娥、宋仁宗、旌旗｜动作：垂帘之后，太后穿着衮服，帘前站着年幼的皇帝｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「真宗死后，十三岁的仁宗即位，刘太后垂帘听政十一年。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (15–22 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Liu E, Song Renzong, banners | Action: Behind the screen the empress dowager sits in ceremonial robes while the young emperor stands before it | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「真宗死后，十三岁的仁宗即位，刘太后垂帘听政十一年。」

shots.vo: 李氏一直默默地生活在宫人之中，被派去守护真宗的陵墓，从不敢自认是皇帝的母亲。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（22–32 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：近山与地面；主体：李宸妃、众人｜动作：一个沉默的妇人跟在先帝陵前的宫人队伍里，从不说话｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：低风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：引文「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李氏一直默默地生活在宫人之中，被派去守护真宗的陵墓，从不敢自认是皇帝的母亲。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (22–32 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Li Chenfei, crowd | Action: A silent woman walks among the palace women at the late emperor's tomb and never speaks | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李氏一直默默地生活在宫人之中，被派去守护真宗的陵墓，从不敢自认是皇帝的母亲。」

shots.vo: 明道元年，李氏病死，刘太后想草草安葬。宰相吕夷简劝她说：如果您还想保全刘氏一族，丧礼就应该从厚。太后终于同意用一品礼殓葬，棺里灌上水银。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（32–48 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：吕夷简、刘娥｜动作：宰相跪在帘前，说宸妃的丧礼要用一品之礼，棺里要灌水银｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「明道元年，李氏病死，刘太后想草草安葬。宰相吕夷简劝她说：如果您还想保全刘氏一族，丧礼就应该从厚。太后终于同意用一品礼殓葬，棺里灌上水银。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (32–48 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Lü Yijian, Liu E | Action: The chief minister kneels before the screen: the consort must be buried with first-rank rites, her coffin filled with mercury | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「明道元年，李氏病死，刘太后想草草安葬。宰相吕夷简劝她说：如果您还想保全刘氏一族，丧礼就应该从厚。太后终于同意用一品礼殓葬，棺里灌上水银。」

shots.vo: 第二年刘太后去世，仁宗的叔父燕王告诉他：陛下是李宸妃所生，她死于非命。仁宗号啕痛哭，好几天不上朝，亲自去洪福院开棺——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（48–62 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、烟；主体：宋仁宗、火；飞白题字「宸妃」｜动作：皇帝亲自打开棺木，母亲的面容如生｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：gong｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「第二年刘太后去世，仁宗的叔父燕王告诉他：陛下是李宸妃所生，她死于非命。仁宗号啕痛哭，好几天不上朝，亲自去洪福院开棺——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (48–62 s, 14 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, smoke; subject: Song Renzong, fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「宸妃」 | Action: The emperor opens the coffin himself and finds his mother's face as if alive | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: gong | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「第二年刘太后去世，仁宗的叔父燕王告诉他：陛下是李宸妃所生，她死于非命。仁宗号啕痛哭，好几天不上朝，亲自去洪福院开棺——」

shots.vo: 仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！
shots.zh: 镜头 6（62–71 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：宋仁宗｜动作：正史结局：仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！」
shots.en: Shot 6 (62–71 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Song Renzong | Action: Canonical outcome: Preserved in mercury and dressed as an empress dowager, she lies unchanged; the emperor sighs that rumours cannot be trusted, treats the Liu clan more generously still, and honours his mother as empress dowager. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！」

shots.vo: 陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（71–77 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」，下署《宋史·后妃传上·李宸妃》；右下角朱印「宸妃」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (71–77 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」 signed 《宋史·后妃传上·李宸妃》; vermilion seal 「宸妃」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、宫殿回响、低风；音效：静默、衣袂摩挲、脚步声、gong；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: quiet room tone, palace hall reverb, low wind; SFX: silence, rustling silk, footsteps, gong; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 宋真宗的刘皇后没有儿子。宫人李氏生下皇子后，刘皇后把孩子抱来当作自己的儿子抚养。宫中上下，没有人敢告诉这个孩子他的生母是谁。
真宗死后，十三岁的仁宗即位，刘太后垂帘听政十一年。
李氏一直默默地生活在宫人之中，被派去守护真宗的陵墓，从不敢自认是皇帝的母亲。
明道元年，李氏病死，刘太后想草草安葬。宰相吕夷简劝她说：如果您还想保全刘氏一族，丧礼就应该从厚。太后终于同意用一品礼殓葬，棺里灌上水银。
第二年刘太后去世，仁宗的叔父燕王告诉他：陛下是李宸妃所生，她死于非命。仁宗号啕痛哭，好几天不上朝，亲自去洪福院开棺——
仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！
陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】北宋 · 狸猫换太子（刘太后与李宸妃）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 77 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：北宋 · 宋仁宗明道元年（1032 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。

人物：
- 刘娥（宋·章献明肃皇后，仁宗嫡母）：女子褙子与抹胸，花冠或高髻；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；取李氏之子为己子，垂帘听政十一年
- 李宸妃（宋·仁宗生母）：女子褙子与抹胸，花冠或高髻；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；终身不敢自认，死后进位宸妃
- 宋仁宗（宋·赵祯）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；太后崩后才知生母
- 吕夷简（宋·宰相）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；劝太后以厚礼殓葬李宸妃，以水银实棺

分镜：
镜头 1（0–15 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：李宸妃、众人｜动作：后宫的一间偏殿里，一个宫女抱着刚出生的孩子，被皇后的人接走了｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：片名「狸猫换太子」竖排书法与朱印「宸妃」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋真宗的刘皇后没有儿子。宫人李氏生下皇子后，刘皇后把孩子抱来当作自己的儿子抚养。宫中上下，没有人敢告诉这个孩子他的生母是谁。」
镜头 2（15–22 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：刘娥、宋仁宗、旌旗｜动作：垂帘之后，太后穿着衮服，帘前站着年幼的皇帝｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「真宗死后，十三岁的仁宗即位，刘太后垂帘听政十一年。」
镜头 3（22–32 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：近山与地面；主体：李宸妃、众人｜动作：一个沉默的妇人跟在先帝陵前的宫人队伍里，从不说话｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：低风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：引文「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李氏一直默默地生活在宫人之中，被派去守护真宗的陵墓，从不敢自认是皇帝的母亲。」
镜头 4（32–48 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：吕夷简、刘娥｜动作：宰相跪在帘前，说宸妃的丧礼要用一品之礼，棺里要灌水银｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「明道元年，李氏病死，刘太后想草草安葬。宰相吕夷简劝她说：如果您还想保全刘氏一族，丧礼就应该从厚。太后终于同意用一品礼殓葬，棺里灌上水银。」
镜头 5（48–62 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、烟；主体：宋仁宗、火；飞白题字「宸妃」｜动作：皇帝亲自打开棺木，母亲的面容如生｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：gong｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「第二年刘太后去世，仁宗的叔父燕王告诉他：陛下是李宸妃所生，她死于非命。仁宗号啕痛哭，好几天不上朝，亲自去洪福院开棺——」
镜头 6（62–71 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：宋仁宗｜动作：正史结局：仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「仁宗看见母亲用水银保存，容貌如生，穿着皇太后的冠服，叹道：人言其可信哉！」
镜头 7（71–77 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」，下署《宋史·后妃传上·李宸妃》；右下角朱印「宸妃」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、宫殿回响、低风；音效：静默、衣袂摩挲、脚步声、gong；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「狸猫换太子」、副题「刘太后与李宸妃」、朱印「宸妃」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」——《宋史·后妃传上·李宸妃》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · A Civet Cat for the Crown Prince: Empress Dowager Liu and Consort Li (「狸猫换太子」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 77 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1032 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Liu E (刘娥) — ruler, Song; women in beizi over a breast-wrap, floral crown or high chignon; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Chenfei (李宸妃) — commoner, Song; women in beizi over a breast-wrap, floral crown or high chignon; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Song Renzong (宋仁宗) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Lü Yijian (吕夷简) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Li Chenfei, crowd | Action: In a side hall of the inner palace a maid holding a newborn hands the child to the empress's people | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「狸猫换太子」 with vermilion seal 「宸妃」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋真宗的刘皇后没有儿子。宫人李氏生下皇子后，刘皇后把孩子抱来当作自己的儿子抚养。宫中上下，没有人敢告诉这个孩子他的生母是谁。」
Shot 2 (15–22 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Liu E, Song Renzong, banners | Action: Behind the screen the empress dowager sits in ceremonial robes while the young emperor stands before it | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「真宗死后，十三岁的仁宗即位，刘太后垂帘听政十一年。」
Shot 3 (22–32 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Li Chenfei, crowd | Action: A silent woman walks among the palace women at the late emperor's tomb and never speaks | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「陛下不以刘氏为念，臣不敢言；尚念刘氏，是丧礼宜从厚。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李氏一直默默地生活在宫人之中，被派去守护真宗的陵墓，从不敢自认是皇帝的母亲。」

strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.title: 好水川
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.subtitle: 李元昊
strings.vo.01: 李元昊称帝，宋朝不肯承认。延州三川口一战，宋军已败了一阵。
strings.vo.02: 韩琦主张进攻，范仲淹主张固守。韩琦命任福率军绕到夏军背后，叮嘱他：违反节度，有功也斩。
strings.vo.03: 任福追击夏军小股，一路深入，到了好水川。夏军且战且走，宋军越追越远。
strings.vo.04: 第二天，道旁出现几只银泥盒子，封得严严实实，里面有东西在动。
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.quote: 吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.fork.prompt: 好水川——依《宋史》直书，还是听词「渔家傲」？
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.pick.canon: 正史 · 《宋史》《续资治通鉴长编》所载
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.canon.intro: 庆历元年二月，泾原路。任福的军队追着几支夏军小队，已经走出很远。前面是一条川谷。
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.end.canon: 鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.legend.discla: 以下取范仲淹《渔家傲》（塞下秋来风景异）为意境，并参照蔡东藩《宋史演义》第二十九回。词作一般认为作于范仲淹戍守西北期间，具体年份未有定说；词中情景为文学，不是战事记录。
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.legend.intro: 范仲淹知延州，修城筑寨，不轻出战。秋天到了，雁阵南飞，边塞的号角从四面响起，孤城在落日中关上了门。
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.end.legend: 一边是好水川的败仗，一边是孤城的长守。两条路都通向议和。
strings.scene.beisong.haoshuichuan.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若任福按约不追（未开放）
