黑白红武侠水墨剪影素材图（水墨特效），题材：好水川·李元昊（1041 年二月）。
画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 箭矢破空。
第 2 行：4. 命中靶心墨点；5. 风卷旗影；6. 蹄下墨尘。
第 3 行：7. 鬃毛飞扬；8. 夜色云雾；9. 烟（过场笔画所绘）。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1536 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。
artPrompts.negative: 文字, 书法, 题字, 印章, 边框, 网格线, 底纹, 纸纹, 背景色, 白底, 阴影, 倒影, 水印, 写实照片, 3D 渲染, 厚涂, 现代器物, 现代服饰, 多余肢体, 五官崩坏, 全彩, 多色, 粉彩, 马卡龙色, Q 版, 萌系, 大头娃娃, 精细繁复纹理, 大量渐变的 CG 质感, 金色高光, 蒸汽朋克机械, 细密界画线条, 细密皴纹, 复杂五官, 日本刀（武士刀）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 庆历元年二月（1041 年二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1041 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

characters.name: 韩琦
characters.zh: 韩琦（宋·陕西安抚副使）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；主张进攻，遣任福出击
characters.en: Han Qi (韩琦) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 任福
characters.zh: 任福（宋·泾原路行营总管）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；好水川战殁
characters.en: Ren Fu (任福) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 桑怿
characters.zh: 桑怿（宋·泾原路都监）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；前锋，好水川战殁
characters.en: Sang Yi (桑怿) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 李元昊
characters.zh: 李元昊（西夏·夏景宗）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；称帝建国，三败宋军
characters.en: Li Yuanhao (李元昊) — ruler, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 范仲淹
characters.zh: 范仲淹（宋·陕西经略安抚副使）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；主张固守，知延州
characters.en: Fan Zhongyan (范仲淹) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 李元昊称帝，宋朝不肯承认。延州三川口一战，宋军已败了一阵。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、河水｜动作：六盘山下，好水川｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「好水川」竖排书法与朱印「好水川」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李元昊称帝，宋朝不肯承认。延州三川口一战，宋军已败了一阵。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, river | Action: Haoshui River below the Liupan mountains | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「好水川」 with vermilion seal 「好水川」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李元昊称帝，宋朝不肯承认。延州三川口一战，宋军已败了一阵。」

shots.vo: 韩琦主张进攻，范仲淹主张固守。韩琦命任福率军绕到夏军背后，叮嘱他：违反节度，有功也斩。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–19 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：韩琦、任福｜动作：韩琦戒任福：违节度者虽有功亦斩｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「韩琦主张进攻，范仲淹主张固守。韩琦命任福率军绕到夏军背后，叮嘱他：违反节度，有功也斩。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–19 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Han Qi, Ren Fu | Action: Han Qi warns Ren Fu: disobey orders and you die even in victory | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「韩琦主张进攻，范仲淹主张固守。韩琦命任福率军绕到夏军背后，叮嘱他：违反节度，有功也斩。」

shots.vo: 任福追击夏军小股，一路深入，到了好水川。夏军且战且走，宋军越追越远。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（19–28 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：草；主体：桑怿、任福｜动作：道旁银泥盒数枚，封裹严密｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「任福追击夏军小股，一路深入，到了好水川。夏军且战且走，宋军越追越远。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (19–28 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Sang Yi, Ren Fu | Action: Sealed silver-clay boxes lie by the road | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「任福追击夏军小股，一路深入，到了好水川。夏军且战且走，宋军越追越远。」

shots.vo: 第二天，道旁出现几只银泥盒子，封得严严实实，里面有东西在动。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（28–36 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：远景：云；主体：旌旗、众人｜动作：盒开，百余只哨鸽飞起｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；云气以淡墨晕染流动；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「第二天，道旁出现几只银泥盒子，封得严严实实，里面有东西在动。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (28–36 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: background: clouds; subject: banners, crowd | Action: The boxes open and over a hundred pigeons fly up | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; clouds as moving pale wash; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「第二天，道旁出现几只银泥盒子，封得严严实实，里面有东西在动。」

shots.vo: 任福打开盒子——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（36–42 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：烟；主体：骑兵、军阵、长兵如林；飞白题字「好水川」｜动作：夏军四面合围｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；四角暗角收拢；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）；画面定格成一幅水墨画｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：放箭｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「任福打开盒子——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (36–42 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: cavalry, army ranks, forest of spears; dry-brush calligraphy 「好水川」 | Action: The Xia army closes in on every side | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「任福打开盒子——」

shots.vo: 鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（42–56 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (42–56 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Ren Fu fights to the death with a dozen arrows in him; after more defeats Song and Xia make peace in 1044. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。」

shots.vo: 吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔
shots.zh: 镜头 7（56–62 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」，下署《宋史·任福传》；右下角朱印「好水川」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」
shots.en: Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」 signed 《宋史·任福传》; vermilion seal 「好水川」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」

sound.zh: 背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、军营鼓声、草原风、远处厮杀声；音效：竹简翻动、衣袂摩挲、阵风、放箭；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, camp drums, steppe wind, distant battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, rustling silk, wind gust, arrow release; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「好水川」、副题「李元昊」、朱印「好水川」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」——《宋史·任福传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「好水川」, subtitle 「李元昊」 and vermilion seal 「好水川」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」 — 《宋史·任福传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

negative.zh: 写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
negative.en: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

narration: 李元昊称帝，宋朝不肯承认。延州三川口一战，宋军已败了一阵。
韩琦主张进攻，范仲淹主张固守。韩琦命任福率军绕到夏军背后，叮嘱他：违反节度，有功也斩。
任福追击夏军小股，一路深入，到了好水川。夏军且战且走，宋军越追越远。
第二天，道旁出现几只银泥盒子，封得严严实实，里面有东西在动。
任福打开盒子——
鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。
吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：北宋 · 庆历元年二月（1041 年二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。

人物：
- 韩琦（宋·陕西安抚副使）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；主张进攻，遣任福出击

- 桑怿（宋·泾原路都监）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；前锋，好水川战殁
- 李元昊（西夏·夏景宗）：党项装束：秃发、圆领窄袖袍、毡冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；称帝建国，三败宋军
- 范仲淹（宋·陕西经略安抚副使）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；主张固守，知延州

分镜：
镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、河水｜动作：六盘山下，好水川｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「好水川」竖排书法与朱印「好水川」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李元昊称帝，宋朝不肯承认。延州三川口一战，宋军已败了一阵。」

镜头 3（19–28 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：草；主体：桑怿、任福｜动作：道旁银泥盒数枚，封裹严密｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「任福追击夏军小股，一路深入，到了好水川。夏军且战且走，宋军越追越远。」
镜头 4（28–36 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：远景：云；主体：旌旗、众人｜动作：盒开，百余只哨鸽飞起｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；云气以淡墨晕染流动；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「第二天，道旁出现几只银泥盒子，封得严严实实，里面有东西在动。」
镜头 5（36–42 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：烟；主体：骑兵、军阵、长兵如林；飞白题字「好水川」｜动作：夏军四面合围｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；四角暗角收拢；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）；画面定格成一幅水墨画｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：放箭｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「任福打开盒子——」
镜头 6（42–56 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。」
镜头 7（56–62 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」，下署《宋史·任福传》；右下角朱印「好水川」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、军营鼓声、草原风、远处厮杀声；音效：竹简翻动、衣袂摩挲、阵风、放箭；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「好水川」、副题「李元昊」、朱印「好水川」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」——《宋史·任福传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · Haoshui River: Li Yuanhao (「好水川」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 62 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1041 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Han Qi (韩琦) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Ren Fu (任福) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sang Yi (桑怿) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Yuanhao (李元昊) — ruler, Western Xia; Tangut dress: shaved head, round-collar narrow-sleeved robe, felt crown; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Fan Zhongyan (范仲淹) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, river | Action: Haoshui River below the Liupan mountains | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「好水川」 with vermilion seal 「好水川」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李元昊称帝，宋朝不肯承认。延州三川口一战，宋军已败了一阵。」
Shot 2 (8–19 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Han Qi, Ren Fu | Action: Han Qi warns Ren Fu: disobey orders and you die even in victory | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「韩琦主张进攻，范仲淹主张固守。韩琦命任福率军绕到夏军背后，叮嘱他：违反节度，有功也斩。」
Shot 3 (19–28 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Sang Yi, Ren Fu | Action: Sealed silver-clay boxes lie by the road | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「任福追击夏军小股，一路深入，到了好水川。夏军且战且走，宋军越追越远。」
Shot 4 (28–36 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: background: clouds; subject: banners, crowd | Action: The boxes open and over a hundred pigeons fly up | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; clouds as moving pale wash; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「第二天，道旁出现几只银泥盒子，封得严严实实，里面有东西在动。」
Shot 5 (36–42 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: cavalry, army ranks, forest of spears; dry-brush calligraphy 「好水川」 | Action: The Xia army closes in on every side | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「任福打开盒子——」
Shot 6 (42–56 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Ren Fu fights to the death with a dozen arrows in him; after more defeats Song and Xia make peace in 1044. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「鸽子飞起，夏军伏兵四合，宋军大败。任福身中十余矢，不肯退走，力战而死，桑怿等亦殁。此后又有定川寨之败，宋夏终于庆历四年议和。」
Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」 signed 《宋史·任福传》; vermilion seal 「好水川」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, camp drums, steppe wind, distant battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, rustling silk, wind gust, arrow release; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「好水川」, subtitle 「李元昊」 and vermilion seal 「好水川」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「吾为大将，兵败，以死报国尔」 — 《宋史·任福传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

shots.note: 印书铺里，一块块雕好的木板堆到了屋顶，每块只能印一页
一个布衣匠人用胶泥捏出小方块，在上面反刻一个字，薄得像铜钱的边
炉火把泥字烧得坚硬，一枚一枚排进木格里
铁板上铺着松脂、蜡和纸灰，泥字排满一框，用火一烤，再用平板一压，字面平得像磨刀石
两块铁板轮流着用，这一板在印，那一板在排，纸一张接一张地揭下来

strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.title: 胶泥活字
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.subtitle: 毕昇
strings.vo.01: 五代以来，刻板印书已经很普遍。可是一部书要刻成几千块木板，刻错一个字，整块板就要重刻，印完以后，书板又占满了屋子。
strings.vo.02: 庆历年间，有一个叫毕昇的平民，想出了另一种办法。他用胶泥刻字，每字一印，薄得像铜钱的边。
strings.vo.03: 刻好的字用火烧硬，按韵分类，用纸条标签贮存在木格里。
strings.vo.04: 印书时，先在铁板上铺一层松脂、蜡和纸灰，放上铁框，把泥字密密排满。拿到火上烤，药熔化了，用平板一压，字面就平整如砥。
strings.vo.05: 他准备两块铁板，一块印刷，一块排字，交替使用。沈括写道——
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.quote: 若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.fork.prompt: 胶泥活字——依《旧五代史》直书，还是听碑刻《英山毕昇墓碑》？
strings.anchor.diaoban: 雕版印书已盛行，五代冯道以来刻印九经
strings.anchor.bitan: 沈括将毕昇活字之法记入《梦溪笔谈》
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.canon.intro: 一个没有官职的平民，用泥巴捏出了一个个小方块。几百年后，人们说这是世界上最早的活字印刷。
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.end.canon: 沈括说，毕昇也试过木头刻字，但木纹有疏有密，沾水后高低不平，又和药粘在一起，所以不如泥字好用。毕昇死后，他的泥字被沈括的堂兄弟们得到，一直珍藏着。
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.pick.legend: 碑刻 · 英山毕昇墓碑
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.legend.disclaimer: 以下取 1990 年湖北英山出土的一块宋代墓碑：碑上刻有“毕昇”之名，有人认为墓主就是发明活字的毕昇，并据此推测他是英山人。但碑文简略，墓主是否即《梦溪笔谈》里的毕昇，学界仍有争议。
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.legend.intro: 一千年后，湖北英山的一个山村里，农民在田里挖出了一块石碑。
strings.scene.beisong.bisheng.end.legend: 不管英山的毕昇是不是那个布衣，《梦溪笔谈》里的三百多字，是关于活字印刷最早的可靠记载。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 五代以来，刻板印书已经很普遍。可是一部书要刻成几千块木板，刻错一个字，整块板就要重刻，印完以后，书板又占满了屋子。
庆历年间，有一个叫毕昇的平民，想出了另一种办法。他用胶泥刻字，每字一印，薄得像铜钱的边。
刻好的字用火烧硬，按韵分类，用纸条标签贮存在木格里。
印书时，先在铁板上铺一层松脂、蜡和纸灰，放上铁框，把泥字密密排满。拿到火上烤，药熔化了，用平板一压，字面就平整如砥。
他准备两块铁板，一块印刷，一块排字，交替使用。沈括写道——
沈括说，毕昇也试过木头刻字，但木纹有疏有密，沾水后高低不平，又和药粘在一起，所以不如泥字好用。
若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】北宋 · 胶泥活字（毕昇）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 72 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：众人｜动作：印书铺里，一块块雕好的木板堆到了屋顶，每块只能印一页｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：片名「胶泥活字」竖排书法与朱印「活板」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「五代以来，刻板印书已经很普遍。可是一部书要刻成几千块木板，刻错一个字，整块板就要重刻，印完以后，书板又占满了屋子。」
镜头 2（14–25 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：毕昇｜动作：一个布衣匠人用胶泥捏出小方块，在上面反刻一个字，薄得像铜钱的边｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：凿石｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「庆历年间，有一个叫毕昇的平民，想出了另一种办法。他用胶泥刻字，每字一印，薄得像铜钱的边。」
镜头 3（25–33 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、烟；主体：毕昇、火｜动作：炉火把泥字烧得坚硬，一枚一枚排进木格里｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：火声；音效：火焰噼啪｜屏幕文字：引文「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刻好的字用火烧硬，按韵分类，用纸条标签贮存在木格里。」
镜头 4（33–46 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：毕昇、印工、火｜动作：铁板上铺着松脂、蜡和纸灰，泥字排满一框，用火一烤，再用平板一压，字面平得像磨刀石｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「印书时，先在铁板上铺一层松脂、蜡和纸灰，放上铁框，把泥字密密排满。拿到火上烤，药熔化了，用平板一压，字面就平整如砥。」
镜头 5（46–54 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：印工、众人；飞白题字「活板」｜动作：两块铁板轮流着用，这一板在印，那一板在排，纸一张接一张地揭下来｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他准备两块铁板，一块印刷，一块排字，交替使用。沈括写道——」
镜头 6（54–66 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：印工｜动作：正史结局：沈括说，毕昇也试过木头刻字，但木纹有疏有密，沾水后高低不平，又和药粘在一起，所以不如泥字好用。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「沈括说，毕昇也试过木头刻字，但木纹有疏有密，沾水后高低不平，又和药粘在一起，所以不如泥字好用。」
镜头 7（66–72 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」，下署《梦溪笔谈·卷十八·技艺》；右下角朱印「活板」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、火声；音效：静默、凿石、火焰噼啪、笔落；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「胶泥活字」、副题「毕昇」、朱印「活板」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」——《梦溪笔谈·卷十八·技艺》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · Clay Movable Type: Bi Sheng (「胶泥活字」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 72 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), c. 1045 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Bi Sheng (毕昇) — commoner, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yin Gong (印工) — commoner, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Shen Kuo (沈括) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: crowd | Action: In a printing shop carved wooden blocks are stacked to the ceiling, each good for a single page | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「胶泥活字」 with vermilion seal 「活板」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「五代以来，刻板印书已经很普遍。可是一部书要刻成几千块木板，刻错一个字，整块板就要重刻，印完以后，书板又占满了屋子。」
Shot 2 (14–25 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Bi Sheng | Action: A commoner craftsman shapes small squares of clay and carves a reversed character into each, thin as a coin's rim | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: chiselling stone | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「庆历年间，有一个叫毕昇的平民，想出了另一种办法。他用胶泥刻字，每字一印，薄得像铜钱的边。」
Shot 3 (25–33 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, smoke; subject: Bi Sheng, fire (splashed ink) | Action: The furnace fires the clay type hard and the pieces are filed one by one into wooden racks | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: crackling fire | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刻好的字用火烧硬，按韵分类，用纸条标签贮存在木格里。」
Shot 4 (33–46 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Bi Sheng, Yin Gong, fire (splashed ink) | Action: On an iron plate spread with resin, wax and paper ash the type fills a frame, is warmed over fire and pressed flat as a whetstone | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「印书时，先在铁板上铺一层松脂、蜡和纸灰，放上铁框，把泥字密密排满。拿到火上烤，药熔化了，用平板一压，字面就平整如砥。」
Shot 5 (46–54 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Yin Gong, crowd; dry-brush calligraphy 「活板」 | Action: Two iron plates take turns, one printing while the other is set, and sheet after sheet is peeled away | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他准备两块铁板，一块印刷，一块排字，交替使用。沈括写道——」
Shot 6 (54–66 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Yin Gong | Action: Canonical outcome: Bi Sheng tried wooden type too, but uneven grain swelled with water and stuck to the paste; after his death his clay type passed to Shen Kuo's kinsmen, who kept it as a treasure. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「沈括说，毕昇也试过木头刻字，但木纹有疏有密，沾水后高低不平，又和药粘在一起，所以不如泥字好用。」
Shot 7 (66–72 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」 signed 《梦溪笔谈·卷十八·技艺》; vermilion seal 「活板」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: quiet room tone, fire; SFX: silence, chiselling stone, crackling fire, brush dropped; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「胶泥活字」, subtitle 「毕昇」 and vermilion seal 「活板」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「若止印三二本，未为简易；若印数十百千本，则极为神速。」 — 《梦溪笔谈·卷十八·技艺》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

天章阁里，皇帝赐笔赐纸，催他把改革的条目写下来

strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.title: 先忧后乐
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.subtitle: 范仲淹与庆历新政
strings.vo.01: 宋夏战争时，范仲淹以文臣身份经略西北，在延州一带修筑城寨，选练士卒，西夏不敢轻易进犯。
strings.vo.02: 庆历三年，范仲淹任参知政事。宋仁宗开天章阁，赐给纸笔，让他当场条陈时政。范仲淹上了十条意见，首先是明黜陟、抑侥幸，整顿冗官，这就是庆历新政。
strings.vo.03: 新政触动了许多人的利益，反对的人说范仲淹、富弼等人结为朋党。不到一年半，新政就废止了，范仲淹出知邠州，后来又移知邓州。
strings.vo.04: 庆历六年，被贬到岳州的老友滕子京重修了岳阳楼，寄来一幅《洞庭晚秋图》，请他写一篇记。
strings.vo.05: 范仲淹没有到过岳阳楼。他在邓州，对着那幅画，写下了一篇文章——
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.quote: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.fork.prompt: 先忧后乐——依《宋史》直书，还是听民谣《五朝名臣言行录》？
strings.anchor.shishi: 范仲淹任参知政事，上《答手诏条陈十事》，庆历新政开始
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.canon.intro: 一个人写了中国最有名的一篇楼记，却从来没有登上过那座楼。
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.end.canon: 范仲淹此后辗转杭州、青州等地，皇祐四年死于赴颍州途中的徐州。庆历新政失败了，但二十多年后，王安石变法又从他开过的地方重新开始。《岳阳楼记》里的“先忧后乐”，成了后世读书人的志向。
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.pick.legend: 民谣 · 五朝名臣言行录
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.legend.disclai: 以下取朱熹辑《五朝名臣言行录》所载宋夏战争时的边地民谣：说范仲淹与韩琦镇守西北，西夏人十分畏惧。属当时流传的歌谣，带有夸饰。
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.legend.intro: 西北边地流传着一首歌谣，唱的是两位从朝廷来的文官。
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.end.legend: 歌谣说：军中有一范，西贼闻之惊破胆。《宋史》也记载，西夏人互相告诫：不要打延州的主意，如今的小范老子腹中自有数万甲兵。
strings.scene.beisong.fanzhongyan.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若庆历新政持续（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 宋夏战争时，范仲淹以文臣身份经略西北，在延州一带修筑城寨，选练士卒，西夏不敢轻易进犯。
庆历三年，范仲淹任参知政事。宋仁宗开天章阁，赐给纸笔，让他当场条陈时政。范仲淹上了十条意见，首先是明黜陟、抑侥幸，整顿冗官，这就是庆历新政。
新政触动了许多人的利益，反对的人说范仲淹、富弼等人结为朋党。不到一年半，新政就废止了，范仲淹出知邠州，后来又移知邓州。
庆历六年，被贬到岳州的老友滕子京重修了岳阳楼，寄来一幅《洞庭晚秋图》，请他写一篇记。
范仲淹没有到过岳阳楼。他在邓州，对着那幅画，写下了一篇文章——
范仲淹此后辗转杭州、青州等地，皇祐四年死于赴颍州途中的徐州。庆历新政失败了，但二十多年后，王安石变法又从他开过的地方重新开始。
先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。

镜头 3（27–41 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：富弼、众人｜动作：朝堂上，被裁汰的官员一个个面色阴沉，流言说他们结为朋党｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「新政触动了许多人的利益，反对的人说范仲淹、富弼等人结为朋党。不到一年半，新政就废止了，范仲淹出知邠州，后来又移知邓州。」
镜头 4（41–52 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、河水、书写；主体：范仲淹｜动作：邓州的书斋里，他展开一幅洞庭湖的画，那是老朋友从岳州寄来的｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「庆历六年，被贬到岳州的老友滕子京重修了岳阳楼，寄来一幅《洞庭晚秋图》，请他写一篇记。」
镜头 5（52–60 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水、书写；主体：范仲淹；飞白题字「先忧」｜动作：他在纸上写下最后一句：先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：低风；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范仲淹没有到过岳阳楼。他在邓州，对着那幅画，写下了一篇文章——」
镜头 6（60–75 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：范仲淹｜动作：正史结局：范仲淹此后辗转杭州、青州等地，皇祐四年死于赴颍州途中的徐州。庆历新政失败了，但二十多年后，王安石变法又从他开过的地方重新开始。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范仲淹此后辗转杭州、青州等地，皇祐四年死于赴颍州途中的徐州。庆历新政失败了，但二十多年后，王安石变法又从他开过的地方重新开始。」
镜头 7（75–81 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」，下署《岳阳楼记·宋范仲淹撰》；右下角朱印「先忧」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：高处疾风、寂静室内、宫殿回响、低风；音效：战鼓、笔落、衣袂摩挲；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「先忧后乐」、副题「范仲淹与庆历新政」、朱印「先忧」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」——《岳阳楼记·宋范仲淹撰》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · First to Worry: Fan Zhongyan and the Qingli Reforms (「先忧后乐」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 81 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1046 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Fan Zhongyan (范仲淹) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Fu Bi (富弼) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Song Renzong (宋仁宗) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Teng Zijing (滕子京) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; subject: Fan Zhongyan, shield wall, banners | Action: On the walls of Yanzhou the northwest wind whips sand as a civil official inspects the forts | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: high wind; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「先忧后乐」 with vermilion seal 「先忧」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋夏战争时，范仲淹以文臣身份经略西北，在延州一带修筑城寨，选练士卒，西夏不敢轻易进犯。」
Shot 2 (11–27 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Song Renzong, Fan Zhongyan | Action: In the Tianzhang Pavilion the emperor hands him brush and paper and presses him to write down his reforms | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「庆历三年，范仲淹任参知政事。宋仁宗开天章阁，赐给纸笔，让他当场条陈时政。范仲淹上了十条意见，首先是明黜陟、抑侥幸，整顿冗官，这就是庆历新政。」
Shot 3 (27–41 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Fu Bi, crowd | Action: At court the officials he has cut stand grim-faced as rumours call them a faction | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「新政触动了许多人的利益，反对的人说范仲淹、富弼等人结为朋党。不到一年半，新政就废止了，范仲淹出知邠州，后来又移知邓州。」
Shot 4 (41–52 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, river, 书写; subject: Fan Zhongyan | Action: In his Dengzhou study he unrolls a painting of Dongting Lake sent by an old friend in Yuezhou | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「庆历六年，被贬到岳州的老友滕子京重修了岳阳楼，寄来一幅《洞庭晚秋图》，请他写一篇记。」
Shot 5 (52–60 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, 书写; subject: Fan Zhongyan; dry-brush calligraphy 「先忧」 | Action: He writes the final line: be first to worry for the world, and last to enjoy its pleasures | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「范仲淹没有到过岳阳楼。他在邓州，对着那幅画，写下了一篇文章——」
Shot 6 (60–75 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Fan Zhongyan | Action: Canonical outcome: Fan serves on in Hangzhou and Qingzhou and dies at Xuzhou in 1052; the reforms fail, but Wang Anshi takes them up again two decades later, and "first to worry, last to rejoice" becomes the scholar's creed. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「范仲淹此后辗转杭州、青州等地，皇祐四年死于赴颍州途中的徐州。庆历新政失败了，但二十多年后，王安石变法又从他开过的地方重新开始。」
Shot 7 (75–81 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」 signed 《岳阳楼记·宋范仲淹撰》; vermilion seal 「先忧」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: high wind, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb, low wind; SFX: war drums, brush dropped, rustling silk; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「先忧后乐」, subtitle 「范仲淹与庆历新政」 and vermilion seal 「先忧」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。」 — 《岳阳楼记·宋范仲淹撰》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.beisong.diqing.title: 夜夺昆仑关
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.subtitle: 狄青
strings.vo.01: 侬智高起兵广源州，攻陷邕州，又围广州五十余日，岭南震动。
strings.vo.02: 出身行伍、脸上还留着刺字的狄青上表请行。他到宾州的第一件事，是斩了违令出战的陈曙等三十二人。
strings.vo.03: 然后他下令按兵不动，正逢上元节，就在城中张灯设宴，一连三夜。
strings.vo.04: 第二夜二鼓，狄青说身体不适，起身入内，请孙沔代他主持酒席。将佐们坐到天亮，不敢离去。
strings.vo.05: 天快亮时，有人飞马来报——
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.quote: 将以有功者为将，不可因循
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.fork.prompt: 夜夺昆仑关——依《宋史》直书，还是听演义《宋史演义》？
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.canon.intro: 皇祐五年正月，宾州。灯已经挂满了城头，营中传令：上元节宴饮三夜。
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.end.canon: 是夜三鼓，狄青已夺昆仑关。大军出关，在归仁铺与侬智高决战，宋军以骑兵冲阵大破之，侬智高焚城逃往大理。岭南平定。
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.legend.disclaimer: 以下按蔡东藩《宋史演义》第三十二回改编。演义依《宋史》本传，铺陈了斩陈曙、上元宴等场面的对话。正史另载狄青在西北作战时披发、戴铜面具，演义亦有引述。
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.legend.intro: 演义写狄青召陈曙到案前，问他出击昆仑关用了多少兵马，陈曙无可隐讳。随后狄青厉声斥责，喝令拿下。
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.end.legend: 演义与正史同归：侬智高败走，狄青凯旋。
strings.scene.beisong.diqing.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若狄青不斩陈曙（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 侬智高起兵广源州，攻陷邕州，又围广州五十余日，岭南震动。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、关门｜动作：宾州城外，昆仑关隐在群山间｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：夜风｜屏幕文字：片名「夜夺昆仑关」竖排书法与朱印「昆仑关」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「侬智高起兵广源州，攻陷邕州，又围广州五十余日，岭南震动。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, gate | Action: Kunlun Pass hidden in hills outside Binzhou | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: night wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「夜夺昆仑关」 with vermilion seal 「昆仑关」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「侬智高起兵广源州，攻陷邕州，又围广州五十余日，岭南震动。」

narration: 侬智高起兵广源州，攻陷邕州，又围广州五十余日，岭南震动。
出身行伍、脸上还留着刺字的狄青上表请行。他到宾州的第一件事，是斩了违令出战的陈曙等三十二人。
然后他下令按兵不动，正逢上元节，就在城中张灯设宴，一连三夜。
第二夜二鼓，狄青说身体不适，起身入内，请孙沔代他主持酒席。将佐们坐到天亮，不敢离去。
天快亮时，有人飞马来报——
是夜三鼓，狄青已夺昆仑关。大军出关，在归仁铺与侬智高决战，宋军以骑兵冲阵大破之，侬智高焚城逃往大理。岭南平定。
将以有功者为将，不可因循

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

镜头 6（44–57 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：狄青｜动作：正史结局：是夜三鼓，狄青已夺昆仑关。大军出关，在归仁铺与侬智高决战，宋军以骑兵冲阵大破之，侬智高焚城逃往大理。岭南平定。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「是夜三鼓，狄青已夺昆仑关。大军出关，在归仁铺与侬智高决战，宋军以骑兵冲阵大破之，侬智高焚城逃往大理。岭南平定。」
镜头 7（57–63 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「将以有功者为将，不可因循」，下署《宋史·狄青传》；右下角朱印「昆仑关」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「将以有功者为将，不可因循」

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：夜风、军营鼓声、人群低语、寂静室内；音效：刀鸣、低语、脚步声、马蹄声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「夜夺昆仑关」、副题「狄青」、朱印「昆仑关」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「将以有功者为将，不可因循」——《宋史·狄青传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · Seizing Kunlun Pass by Night: Di Qing (「夜夺昆仑关」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 63 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1053 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Di Qing (狄青) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sun Mian (孙沔) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Chen Shu (陈曙) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Nong Zhigao (侬智高) — ruler, Nantianguo; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yu Jing (余靖) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, gate | Action: Kunlun Pass hidden in hills outside Binzhou | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: night wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「夜夺昆仑关」 with vermilion seal 「昆仑关」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「侬智高起兵广源州，攻陷邕州，又围广州五十余日，岭南震动。」
Shot 2 (8–20 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Di Qing, Chen Shu, broadsword | Action: Di Qing executes thirty-two officers who disobeyed orders | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「出身行伍、脸上还留着刺字的狄青上表请行。他到宾州的第一件事，是斩了违令出战的陈曙等三十二人。」
Shot 3 (20–28 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: crenellated city wall; subject: crowd, fire (splashed ink) | Action: Binzhou hangs lanterns for three nights of the Lantern Festival | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements; moon left blank with pale wash around it; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「将以有功者为将，不可因循」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「然后他下令按兵不动，正逢上元节，就在城中张灯设宴，一连三夜。」
Shot 4 (28–38 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sun Mian | Action: At the second watch Di Qing leaves the feast pleading illness | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「第二夜二鼓，狄青说身体不适，起身入内，请孙沔代他主持酒席。将佐们坐到天亮，不敢离去。」
Shot 5 (38–44 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Di Qing, cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「雨」「昆仑」 | Action: Crossing Kunlun Pass on a night of wind and rain | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; ink spatters where hooves strike; fine slanted strokes for rain; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天快亮时，有人飞马来报——」
Shot 6 (44–57 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Di Qing | Action: Canonical outcome: By the third watch the pass is taken; Song cavalry crush Nong Zhigao at Guiren and Lingnan is pacified. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「是夜三鼓，狄青已夺昆仑关。大军出关，在归仁铺与侬智高决战，宋军以骑兵冲阵大破之，侬智高焚城逃往大理。岭南平定。」
Shot 7 (57–63 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「将以有功者为将，不可因循」 signed 《宋史·狄青传》; vermilion seal 「昆仑关」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「将以有功者为将，不可因循」

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: night wind, camp drums, crowd murmur, quiet room tone; SFX: ringing blade, murmuring, footsteps, hoofbeats; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「夜夺昆仑关」, subtitle 「狄青」 and vermilion seal 「昆仑关」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「将以有功者为将，不可因循」 — 《宋史·狄青传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.beisong.baogong.title: 包公知开封
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.subtitle: 包拯
strings.vo.01: 嘉祐年间，包拯权知开封府。他平日不苟言笑，人说要见包拯一笑，比黄河水清还难。
strings.vo.02: 旧制，百姓告状不能直入府门，要先交给门牌司转递，胥吏从中上下其手。包拯下令打开正门，让诉者直到堂前陈说。
strings.vo.03: 那年京师大水。包拯查得，是中官和权贵在惠民河上修筑园林台榭，堵塞了河道。
strings.vo.04: 他下令全部拆毁。有人拿着地券前来争辩，说这块地本是自家所有。
strings.vo.05: 包拯细看地券上的步数——
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.fork.prompt: 包公知开封——依《宋史》直书，还是听戏曲「包公戏」？
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.canon.intro: 开封府的正门从来是关着的。今天一早，衙役奉命把它打开了。门外站着一个不知所措的告状人。
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.end.canon: 伪造的地券被一一验明，包拯上奏弹劾。河道疏通，京师水患得以缓解。贵戚宦官为之敛手，京城传言：关节不到，有阎罗包老。
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.legend.disclaimer: 以下取元杂剧与清代说唱小说中的包公故事：元杂剧《陈州粜米》、清《三侠五义》中的“狸猫换太子”等。这些都是后世戏曲小说，正史并无其事。蔡东藩在《宋史演义》第三十二回也说，后人所撰《包公案》只有一半实迹。
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.legend.intro: 戏台上的包公黑面白月，日断阳、夜断阴，开封府堂前排着三口铜铡。一桩宫中二十年前的旧案，被一个盲眼老妇人带到了他面前。
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.end.legend: 戏曲里的青天和正史里的阎罗包老，是同一个不肯通关节的人。
strings.scene.beisong.baogong.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若包拯不开正门（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 嘉祐二年（1057 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1057 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

characters.name: 包拯
characters.zh: 包拯（宋·权知开封府）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；立朝刚毅，京师称“阎罗包老”
characters.en: Bao Zheng (包拯) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 赵祯
characters.zh: 赵祯（宋·宋仁宗）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；在位四十余年
characters.en: Zhao Zhen (赵祯) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 诉讼者
characters.zh: 诉讼者（宋·开封百姓）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；过去须由门牌司递状，见不到知府
characters.en: Su Songzhe (诉讼者) — commoner, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 嘉祐年间，包拯权知开封府。他平日不苟言笑，人说要见包拯一笑，比黄河水清还难。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：众人｜动作：开封府衙，正门洞开｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：片名「包公知开封」竖排书法与朱印「包拯」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「嘉祐年间，包拯权知开封府。他平日不苟言笑，人说要见包拯一笑，比黄河水清还难。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: crowd | Action: The main gate of Kaifeng prefecture opened wide | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「包公知开封」 with vermilion seal 「包拯」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「嘉祐年间，包拯权知开封府。他平日不苟言笑，人说要见包拯一笑，比黄河水清还难。」

shots.vo: 旧制，百姓告状不能直入府门，要先交给门牌司转递，胥吏从中上下其手。包拯下令打开正门，让诉者直到堂前陈说。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–23 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：包拯、众人｜动作：诉者直至堂前，自陈曲直｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「旧制，百姓告状不能直入府门，要先交给门牌司转递，胥吏从中上下其手。包拯下令打开正门，让诉者直到堂前陈说。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–23 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Bao Zheng, crowd | Action: Petitioners walk straight to the hall to state their case | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「旧制，百姓告状不能直入府门，要先交给门牌司转递，胥吏从中上下其手。包拯下令打开正门，让诉者直到堂前陈说。」

shots.vo: 那年京师大水。包拯查得，是中官和权贵在惠民河上修筑园林台榭，堵塞了河道。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（23–33 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水、城墙雉堞、洪水｜动作：惠民河道，权贵园榭侵占河身｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：水势奔涌｜屏幕文字：引文「关节不到，有阎罗包老」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「那年京师大水。包拯查得，是中官和权贵在惠民河上修筑园林台榭，堵塞了河道。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (23–33 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river, crenellated city wall, flood waters | Action: Along the Huimin River, nobles' gardens encroach on the channel | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; scorched-ink outline of battlements; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: surging water | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「关节不到，有阎罗包老」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「那年京师大水。包拯查得，是中官和权贵在惠民河上修筑园林台榭，堵塞了河道。」

shots.vo: 他下令全部拆毁。有人拿着地券前来争辩，说这块地本是自家所有。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（33–41 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：卷轴、地券；主体：包拯｜动作：地契上的步数有涂改的痕迹｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他下令全部拆毁。有人拿着地券前来争辩，说这块地本是自家所有。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (33–41 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: scroll, 地券; subject: Bao Zheng | Action: The figures on the deed show signs of tampering | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他下令全部拆毁。有人拿着地券前来争辩，说这块地本是自家所有。」

shots.vo: 包拯细看地券上的步数——

narration: 嘉祐年间，包拯权知开封府。他平日不苟言笑，人说要见包拯一笑，比黄河水清还难。
旧制，百姓告状不能直入府门，要先交给门牌司转递，胥吏从中上下其手。包拯下令打开正门，让诉者直到堂前陈说。
那年京师大水。包拯查得，是中官和权贵在惠民河上修筑园林台榭，堵塞了河道。
他下令全部拆毁。有人拿着地券前来争辩，说这块地本是自家所有。
包拯细看地券上的步数——
伪造的地券被一一验明，包拯上奏弹劾。河道疏通，京师水患得以缓解。贵戚宦官为之敛手，京城传言：关节不到，有阎罗包老。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · Lord Bao Governs Kaifeng: Bao Zheng (「包公知开封」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 66 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1057 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Bao Zheng (包拯) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhao Zhen (赵祯) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.title: 千年一榜
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.subtitle: 欧阳修知贡举
strings.vo.01: 北宋中期，太学里流行一种文风，追求生僻怪异的字句，叫作太学体。
strings.vo.02: 嘉祐二年，翰林学士欧阳修主持礼部考试。凡是写太学体的卷子，他一律黜落。
strings.vo.03: 考官梅尧臣读到一份论刑赏的卷子，文章平易而有气势，赶紧推荐给欧阳修。
strings.vo.04: 欧阳修也很欣赏，却以为是自己的门客曾巩写的，为了避嫌，把它定为第二。
strings.vo.05: 拆开糊名一看，作者是一个从四川眉山来的年轻人——
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.quote: 时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.fork.prompt: 千年一榜——依《宋史》直书，还是听诗话《诚斋诗话》？
strings.anchor.taixueti: 太学体盛行，士子竞为险怪奇涩之文
strings.anchor.sushi: 苏轼、苏辙兄弟同榜进士及第，名动京师
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.canon.intro: 一位考官把一份好卷子降成了第二名，因为他以为那是自己学生写的。
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.end.canon: 嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。可是从此以后，场屋的文风变得平易了。
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.legend.disclaime: 以下取南宋杨万里《诚斋诗话》的记载：苏轼卷中引了一个尧与皋陶的典故，欧阳修和梅尧臣都不知出处，后来问苏轼，苏轼说“想当然耳”。属南宋人的笔记，细节未必确实。
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.legend.intro: 杨万里说，苏轼的文章里写：皋陶三次说要杀，尧三次说要宽赦。考官们翻遍了书，也没找到出处。
strings.scene.beisong.ouyangxiu.end.legend: 苏轼说：以今日之事推测，想当然耳。欧阳修事后对人说：此人可谓善读书，善用书，他日文章必独步天下。他在给梅尧臣的信里写道：老夫当避路，放他出一头地。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 宋仁宗嘉祐二年（1057 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1057 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

characters.name: 欧阳修
characters.zh: 欧阳修（宋·翰林学士，知贡举）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；痛排太学体，取苏轼、曾巩等
characters.en: Ouyang Xiu (欧阳修) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
