shots.vo: 北宋中期，太学里流行一种文风，追求生僻怪异的字句，叫作太学体。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：众人、旌旗｜动作：贡院里，数千名举子鱼贯而入，考官们在帘后等待｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：片名「千年一榜」竖排书法与朱印「出头」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北宋中期，太学里流行一种文风，追求生僻怪异的字句，叫作太学体。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd, banners | Action: Thousands of candidates file into the examination hall while the examiners wait behind the screen | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「千年一榜」 with vermilion seal 「出头」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北宋中期，太学里流行一种文风，追求生僻怪异的字句，叫作太学体。」

shots.vo: 嘉祐二年，翰林学士欧阳修主持礼部考试。凡是写太学体的卷子，他一律黜落。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：欧阳修｜动作：主考官提起朱笔，把一份满纸怪字的卷子从头到尾抹了一道｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「嘉祐二年，翰林学士欧阳修主持礼部考试。凡是写太学体的卷子，他一律黜落。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Ouyang Xiu | Action: The chief examiner lifts his red brush and strikes through a paper full of strange characters from top to bottom | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「嘉祐二年，翰林学士欧阳修主持礼部考试。凡是写太学体的卷子，他一律黜落。」

shots.vo: 考官梅尧臣读到一份论刑赏的卷子，文章平易而有气势，赶紧推荐给欧阳修。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（17–26 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：梅尧臣、欧阳修｜动作：另一份卷子让考官们读得拍案叫好，梅尧臣捧着它来找主考｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「考官梅尧臣读到一份论刑赏的卷子，文章平易而有气势，赶紧推荐给欧阳修。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (17–26 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Mei Yaochen, Ouyang Xiu | Action: Another paper has the examiners slapping the table, and Mei Yaochen carries it to the chief examiner | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「考官梅尧臣读到一份论刑赏的卷子，文章平易而有气势，赶紧推荐给欧阳修。」

shots.vo: 欧阳修也很欣赏，却以为是自己的门客曾巩写的，为了避嫌，把它定为第二。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（26–35 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：欧阳修｜动作：主考官怀疑是自己的门客曾巩所作，为了避嫌，只给了第二名｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「欧阳修也很欣赏，却以为是自己的门客曾巩写的，为了避嫌，把它定为第二。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (26–35 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Ouyang Xiu | Action: Suspecting it is by his own protégé Zeng Gong, the examiner ranks it only second to avoid favouritism | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「欧阳修也很欣赏，却以为是自己的门客曾巩写的，为了避嫌，把它定为第二。」

shots.vo: 拆开糊名一看，作者是一个从四川眉山来的年轻人——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（35–42 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：苏轼、苏辙；飞白题字「出头」｜动作：拆开糊名，卷子上写着两个字：苏轼｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「拆开糊名一看，作者是一个从四川眉山来的年轻人——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (35–42 s, 7 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Su Shi, Su Zhe; dry-brush calligraphy 「出头」 | Action: The sealed name is opened and reads: Su Shi | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「拆开糊名一看，作者是一个从四川眉山来的年轻人——」

shots.vo: 嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（42–58 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：苏轼、苏辙｜动作：正史结局：嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (42–58 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Su Shi, Su Zhe | Action: Canonical outcome: The 1057 roll includes Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong, Zhang Zai and Cheng Hao; failed candidates jeer at Ouyang in the street, but from then on examination prose turns plain. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。」

shots.vo: 时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（58–64 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」，下署《宋史·欧阳修传》；右下角朱印「出头」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (58–64 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」 signed 《宋史·欧阳修传》; vermilion seal 「出头」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：人群低语、寂静室内、宫殿回响；音效：脚步声、笔落、衣袂摩挲、静默；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: crowd murmur, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb; SFX: footsteps, brush dropped, rustling silk, silence; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「千年一榜」、副题「欧阳修知贡举」、朱印「出头」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」——《宋史·欧阳修传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「千年一榜」, subtitle 「欧阳修知贡举」 and vermilion seal 「出头」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」 — 《宋史·欧阳修传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 北宋中期，太学里流行一种文风，追求生僻怪异的字句，叫作太学体。
嘉祐二年，翰林学士欧阳修主持礼部考试。凡是写太学体的卷子，他一律黜落。
考官梅尧臣读到一份论刑赏的卷子，文章平易而有气势，赶紧推荐给欧阳修。
欧阳修也很欣赏，却以为是自己的门客曾巩写的，为了避嫌，把它定为第二。
拆开糊名一看，作者是一个从四川眉山来的年轻人——
嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。
时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。

【水墨视频生成提示词】北宋 · 千年一榜（欧阳修知贡举）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 64 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：北宋 · 宋仁宗嘉祐二年（1057 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。

人物：
- 欧阳修（宋·翰林学士，知贡举）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；痛排太学体，取苏轼、曾巩等
- 梅尧臣（宋·点检试卷官）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；荐苏轼之卷于欧阳修
- 苏轼（宋·眉山举子）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；以《刑赏忠厚之至论》中第
- 苏辙（宋·苏轼之弟）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与兄同榜
- 曾巩（宋·南丰举子）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；同榜进士

分镜：
镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：众人、旌旗｜动作：贡院里，数千名举子鱼贯而入，考官们在帘后等待｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：片名「千年一榜」竖排书法与朱印「出头」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北宋中期，太学里流行一种文风，追求生僻怪异的字句，叫作太学体。」
镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：欧阳修｜动作：主考官提起朱笔，把一份满纸怪字的卷子从头到尾抹了一道｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「嘉祐二年，翰林学士欧阳修主持礼部考试。凡是写太学体的卷子，他一律黜落。」
镜头 3（17–26 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：梅尧臣、欧阳修｜动作：另一份卷子让考官们读得拍案叫好，梅尧臣捧着它来找主考｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「考官梅尧臣读到一份论刑赏的卷子，文章平易而有气势，赶紧推荐给欧阳修。」
镜头 4（26–35 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：欧阳修｜动作：主考官怀疑是自己的门客曾巩所作，为了避嫌，只给了第二名｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「欧阳修也很欣赏，却以为是自己的门客曾巩写的，为了避嫌，把它定为第二。」
镜头 5（35–42 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：苏轼、苏辙；飞白题字「出头」｜动作：拆开糊名，卷子上写着两个字：苏轼｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「拆开糊名一看，作者是一个从四川眉山来的年轻人——」
镜头 6（42–58 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：苏轼、苏辙｜动作：正史结局：嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。」
镜头 7（58–64 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」，下署《宋史·欧阳修传》；右下角朱印「出头」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：人群低语、寂静室内、宫殿回响；音效：脚步声、笔落、衣袂摩挲、静默；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「千年一榜」、副题「欧阳修知贡举」、朱印「出头」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」——《宋史·欧阳修传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · The Roll of a Thousand Years: Ouyang Xiu Sets the Exam (「千年一榜」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 64 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1057 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Ouyang Xiu (欧阳修) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Mei Yaochen (梅尧臣) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Su Shi (苏轼) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Su Zhe (苏辙) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zeng Gong (曾巩) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd, banners | Action: Thousands of candidates file into the examination hall while the examiners wait behind the screen | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「千年一榜」 with vermilion seal 「出头」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北宋中期，太学里流行一种文风，追求生僻怪异的字句，叫作太学体。」
Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Ouyang Xiu | Action: The chief examiner lifts his red brush and strikes through a paper full of strange characters from top to bottom | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「嘉祐二年，翰林学士欧阳修主持礼部考试。凡是写太学体的卷子，他一律黜落。」
Shot 3 (17–26 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Mei Yaochen, Ouyang Xiu | Action: Another paper has the examiners slapping the table, and Mei Yaochen carries it to the chief examiner | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「考官梅尧臣读到一份论刑赏的卷子，文章平易而有气势，赶紧推荐给欧阳修。」
Shot 4 (26–35 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Ouyang Xiu | Action: Suspecting it is by his own protégé Zeng Gong, the examiner ranks it only second to avoid favouritism | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「欧阳修也很欣赏，却以为是自己的门客曾巩写的，为了避嫌，把它定为第二。」
Shot 5 (35–42 s, 7 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Su Shi, Su Zhe; dry-brush calligraphy 「出头」 | Action: The sealed name is opened and reads: Su Shi | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「拆开糊名一看，作者是一个从四川眉山来的年轻人——」
Shot 6 (42–58 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Su Shi, Su Zhe | Action: Canonical outcome: The 1057 roll includes Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong, Zhang Zai and Cheng Hao; failed candidates jeer at Ouyang in the street, but from then on examination prose turns plain. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「嘉祐二年这一榜，录取了苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等人，后世称为千年一榜。落榜的举子等在欧阳修上朝的路上群聚诋骂，连巡街的兵卒都制止不住。」
Shot 7 (58–64 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」 signed 《宋史·欧阳修传》; vermilion seal 「出头」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「时士子尚为险怪奇涩之文，号太学体，修痛排抑之，凡如是者辄黜。」

strings.scene.beisong.xining.title: 熙宁变法
strings.scene.beisong.xining.subtitle: 王安石
strings.vo.01: 宋神宗即位，国用不足，边事不振。他起用王安石，锐意改革。
strings.vo.02: 熙宁二年，王安石任参知政事，设置制置三司条例司，主持变法。
strings.vo.03: 青苗法、免役法、保甲法、市易法相继推行。
strings.vo.04: 司马光等人激烈反对。熙宁七年大旱，郑侠绘《流民图》上奏。
strings.scene.beisong.xining.fork.prompt: 熙宁变法——依《宋史》直书，还是听野史「拗相公」？
strings.scene.beisong.xining.canon.intro: 熙宁元年，年轻的神宗召王安石越次入对，问：唐太宗何如？王安石答：陛下当法尧舜，何以太宗为哉！
strings.scene.beisong.xining.end.canon: 王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。
strings.scene.beisong.xining.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自明代冯梦龙编《警世通言》中的话本《拗相公饮恨半山堂》，带有强烈的贬抑色彩，属于小说家言。
strings.scene.beisong.xining.legend.intro: 话本写王安石罢相南归，一路微服，所到之处听见百姓怨骂新法，墙上题诗讥刺“拗相公”，终至郁郁而终。
strings.scene.beisong.xining.end.legend: 话本的结局与史实不同，但人物的结局都落在江宁。小说汇回正史：新法终被废止。
strings.scene.beisong.xining.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若神宗多活二十年（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

characters.en: Zheng Xia (郑侠) — commoner, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 宋神宗即位，国用不足，边事不振。他起用王安石，锐意改革。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、河水｜动作：汴京，熙宁二年｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「熙宁变法」竖排书法与朱印「熙宁」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋神宗即位，国用不足，边事不振。他起用王安石，锐意改革。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, river | Action: Bianjing in 1069 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「熙宁变法」 with vermilion seal 「熙宁」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋神宗即位，国用不足，边事不振。他起用王安石，锐意改革。」

shots.vo: 熙宁二年，王安石任参知政事，设置制置三司条例司，主持变法。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–16 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：宋神宗、王安石｜动作：君臣对谈：当以何为先｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「熙宁二年，王安石任参知政事，设置制置三司条例司，主持变法。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Song Shenzong, Wang Anshi | Action: Emperor and minister discuss what comes first | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「熙宁二年，王安石任参知政事，设置制置三司条例司，主持变法。」

shots.vo: 青苗法、免役法、保甲法、市易法相继推行。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–22 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：卷轴、法｜动作：青苗、免役、保甲，一道道新法｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「青苗法、免役法、保甲法、市易法相继推行。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll, 法 | Action: Green Sprouts, hired service, baojia—one new law after another | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「青苗法、免役法、保甲法、市易法相继推行。」

shots.vo: 司马光等人激烈反对。熙宁七年大旱，郑侠绘《流民图》上奏。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（22–30 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：中景：沙；主体：郑侠、众人｜动作：旱灾，流民图｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「司马光等人激烈反对。熙宁七年大旱，郑侠绘《流民图》上奏。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (22–30 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: sand; subject: Zheng Xia, crowd | Action: Drought and the Picture of Refugees | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「司马光等人激烈反对。熙宁七年大旱，郑侠绘《流民图》上奏。」

shots.vo: 新法与旧党之间——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（30–36 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：新、旧；飞白题字「党争」｜动作：新旧之争｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「新法与旧党之间——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 新, 旧; dry-brush calligraphy 「党争」 | Action: Reformers against conservatives | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「新法与旧党之间——」

shots.vo: 王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（36–46 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (36–46 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Wang Anshi resigns twice; after Shenzong's death Sima Guang scraps the reforms and factional strife lasts until the dynasty's end. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（46–52 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「熙宁」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处
shots.en: Shot 7 (46–52 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「熙宁」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

sound.zh: 背景乐：笛子，清丽，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、战后余风；音效：竹简翻动、笔落、低语；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: dizi flute, clear and lyrical, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, brush dropped, murmuring; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「熙宁变法」、副题「王安石」、朱印「熙宁」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「熙宁变法」, subtitle 「王安石」 and vermilion seal 「熙宁」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; overlaid text must match the source exactly

negative.en: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

narration: 宋神宗即位，国用不足，边事不振。他起用王安石，锐意改革。
熙宁二年，王安石任参知政事，设置制置三司条例司，主持变法。
青苗法、免役法、保甲法、市易法相继推行。
司马光等人激烈反对。熙宁七年大旱，郑侠绘《流民图》上奏。
新法与旧党之间——
王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】北宋 · 熙宁变法（王安石）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 52 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：北宋 · 宋熙宁二年至元丰八年（1069—1085 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。

镜头 5（30–36 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：新、旧；飞白题字「党争」｜动作：新旧之争｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「新法与旧党之间——」
镜头 6（36–46 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。」
镜头 7（46–52 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「熙宁」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：笛子，清丽，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、战后余风；音效：竹简翻动、笔落、低语；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「熙宁变法」、副题「王安石」、朱印「熙宁」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · The Xining Reforms: Wang Anshi (「熙宁变法」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 52 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1069 CE–1085 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Wang Anshi (王安石) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Song Shenzong (宋神宗) — ruler, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zheng Xia (郑侠) — commoner, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sima Guang (司马光) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Lü Huiqing (吕惠卿) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Su Shi (苏轼) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, river | Action: Bianjing in 1069 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「熙宁变法」 with vermilion seal 「熙宁」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋神宗即位，国用不足，边事不振。他起用王安石，锐意改革。」
Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Song Shenzong, Wang Anshi | Action: Emperor and minister discuss what comes first | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「熙宁二年，王安石任参知政事，设置制置三司条例司，主持变法。」
Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll, 法 | Action: Green Sprouts, hired service, baojia—one new law after another | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「青苗法、免役法、保甲法、市易法相继推行。」
Shot 4 (22–30 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: sand; subject: Zheng Xia, crowd | Action: Drought and the Picture of Refugees | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「司马光等人激烈反对。熙宁七年大旱，郑侠绘《流民图》上奏。」
Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 新, 旧; dry-brush calligraphy 「党争」 | Action: Reformers against conservatives | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「新法与旧党之间——」
Shot 6 (36–46 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Wang Anshi resigns twice; after Shenzong's death Sima Guang scraps the reforms and factional strife lasts until the dynasty's end. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「王安石两度罢相，退居江宁。神宗去世后，司马光主政，尽废新法。新旧党争延续到北宋末年。」
Shot 7 (46–52 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「熙宁」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: dizi flute, clear and lyrical, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, brush dropped, murmuring; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「熙宁变法」, subtitle 「王安石」 and vermilion seal 「熙宁」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

他找到一份旧日的划界文书：以古长城为界，而辽人要的地方在长城以南

strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.title: 枢密院的旧档
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.subtitle: 沈括使辽
strings.vo.01: 熙宁七年起，辽国派使臣萧禧来宋，要求重新划定河东的边界，把黄嵬山一带的土地划归辽国。萧禧住在宋朝的驿馆里不肯走。
strings.vo.02: 翰林学士沈括奉命到枢密院查阅旧档，找到了当年双方议定地界的文书，上面写明以古长城为界，而辽人所争之地，在长城以南。
strings.vo.03: 宋神宗大喜，派沈括出使辽国回谢。他一路北行，把经过的山川、道路和风俗都记录下来，画成地图。
strings.vo.04: 在辽国，宰相杨益戒六次与他会谈，反复争论。
strings.vo.05: 每一次，沈括都拿出旧档中的文字来回答——
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.quote: 鄜、延境内有石油……此物后必大行于世。
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.fork.prompt: 枢密院的旧档——依《宋史》直书，还是听笔记《萍洲可谈》？
strings.anchor.xiaoxi: 辽使萧禧来宋，争河东代北地界
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.canon.intro: 一场边界争端，最后是靠一份积满灰尘的旧文书解决的。找到它的人，后来写了一部包罗万象的笔记。
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.end.canon: 辽人理屈，这次争地没有得逞。沈括回国后上《使契丹图抄》。几年后，他到延州主持对西夏的边防，在那里注意到当地人采来燃烧、烟浓如墨的“石油”，还试着用它的烟制墨。元丰五年，永乐城被西夏攻陷，沈括坐贬，晚年居润州梦溪园，写成了《梦溪笔谈》。
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.legend.disclaimer: 以下取北宋朱彧《萍洲可谈》的记载：说沈括晚年娶的妻子张氏极为凶悍，经常打骂沈括，甚至扯下他的胡须。属当时人的笔记，带有戏谑。
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.legend.intro: 萍洲可谈里说，那个在辽廷让宰相无言以对的沈括，回到家里却怕极了自己的妻子。
strings.scene.beisong.shenkuo.end.legend: 萍洲可谈说，张氏死后，大家都替沈括庆幸，他却终日恍惚，过了不久也去世了。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 宋神宗熙宁八年（1075 年）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1075 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

characters.en: Shen Kuo (沈括) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 熙宁七年起，辽国派使臣萧禧来宋，要求重新划定河东的边界，把黄嵬山一带的土地划归辽国。萧禧住在宋朝的驿馆里不肯走。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：沈括｜动作：枢密院的库房里，一个官员在灰尘里一卷一卷地翻找旧文书｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「枢密院的旧档」竖排书法与朱印「定界」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「熙宁七年起，辽国派使臣萧禧来宋，要求重新划定河东的边界，把黄嵬山一带的土地划归辽国。萧禧住在宋朝的驿馆里不肯走。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Shen Kuo | Action: In the Bureau of Military Affairs archive an official searches roll by roll through the dust | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「枢密院的旧档」 with vermilion seal 「定界」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「熙宁七年起，辽国派使臣萧禧来宋，要求重新划定河东的边界，把黄嵬山一带的土地划归辽国。萧禧住在宋朝的驿馆里不肯走。」

shots.vo: 翰林学士沈括奉命到枢密院查阅旧档，找到了当年双方议定地界的文书，上面写明以古长城为界，而辽人所争之地，在长城以南。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（14–28 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：沈括、盾墙｜动作：他找到一份旧日的划界文书：以古长城为界，而辽人要的地方在长城以南｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「翰林学士沈括奉命到枢密院查阅旧档，找到了当年双方议定地界的文书，上面写明以古长城为界，而辽人所争之地，在长城以南。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (14–28 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Shen Kuo, shield wall | Action: He finds an old boundary agreement naming the ancient Great Wall as the line, while the Liao claim land south of it | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「翰林学士沈括奉命到枢密院查阅旧档，找到了当年双方议定地界的文书，上面写明以古长城为界，而辽人所争之地，在长城以南。」

shots.vo: 宋神宗大喜，派沈括出使辽国回谢。他一路北行，把经过的山川、道路和风俗都记录下来，画成地图。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（28–39 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；主体：沈括、战马；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：他带着这份文书和随从，冒着风雪北上，一路记下所经的山川｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片｜声音：环境：高处疾风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：引文「鄜、延境内有石油……此物后必大行于世。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋神宗大喜，派沈括出使辽国回谢。他一路北行，把经过的山川、道路和风俗都记录下来，画成地图。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (28–39 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; subject: Shen Kuo, war horse; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: With the document and his escort he rides north through snow, recording every mountain and river | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: high wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「鄜、延境内有石油……此物后必大行于世。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋神宗大喜，派沈括出使辽国回谢。他一路北行，把经过的山川、道路和风俗都记录下来，画成地图。」

shots.vo: 在辽国，宰相杨益戒六次与他会谈，反复争论。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（39–45 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：沈括、杨益戒、旌旗｜动作：辽国的帐中，宰相一次次发问，他一条条用文书作答｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「在辽国，宰相杨益戒六次与他会谈，反复争论。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (39–45 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Shen Kuo, Yang Yijie, banners | Action: In the Liao tent the chief minister questions him again and again, and he answers each point from the documents | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「在辽国，宰相杨益戒六次与他会谈，反复争论。」

shots.vo: 每一次，沈括都拿出旧档中的文字来回答——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：营帐、书写；主体：沈括、杨益戒；飞白题字「定界」｜动作：辽人终于说不出话来，他收起文书，起身告辞｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：高处疾风；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「每一次，沈括都拿出旧档中的文字来回答——」

narration: 熙宁七年起，辽国派使臣萧禧来宋，要求重新划定河东的边界，把黄嵬山一带的土地划归辽国。萧禧住在宋朝的驿馆里不肯走。
翰林学士沈括奉命到枢密院查阅旧档，找到了当年双方议定地界的文书，上面写明以古长城为界，而辽人所争之地，在长城以南。
宋神宗大喜，派沈括出使辽国回谢。他一路北行，把经过的山川、道路和风俗都记录下来，画成地图。
在辽国，宰相杨益戒六次与他会谈，反复争论。
每一次，沈括都拿出旧档中的文字来回答——
辽人理屈，这次争地没有得逞。沈括回国后上《使契丹图抄》。
鄜、延境内有石油……此物后必大行于世。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · The Old Files of the Bureau: Shen Kuo's Embassy to Liao (「枢密院的旧档」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 65 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1075 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

strings.scene.beisong.wutai.title: 乌台诗案
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.subtitle: 苏轼
strings.vo.01: 元丰二年，苏轼由徐州调任湖州。他在谢上表里发了几句牢骚，又有不少诗文讽刺新法。
strings.vo.02: 御史中丞李定、监察御史舒亶、何正臣摘出他的表语和诗句，弹劾他讥讽朝政。七月，台卒到湖州把他押解进京。
strings.vo.03: 御史台院中多柏树，常有乌鸦栖息，所以被称作乌台。苏轼在这里被关了一百多天，反复审讯。
strings.vo.04: 据宋人笔记，苏轼与长子苏迈约定，平时送饭只送菜和肉，若有不测，就送鱼。一天苏迈出外借钱，托亲戚代送，亲戚不知约定，送去了一条鱼。
strings.vo.05: 苏轼大惊，以为必死，在狱中写下两首诗寄给弟弟苏辙——
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.quote: 是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.fork.prompt: 乌台诗案——依《宋史》直书，还是听笔记「送鱼之约」？
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《宋史·苏轼传》《续资治通鉴长编》所载
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.canon.intro: 一个诗人因为诗下了狱。案卷里每一句诗都被逐字拆解，看有没有“讥讽”。
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.end.canon: 神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。到黄州后，他在城东的坡地上开荒种地，自号东坡居士。
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.legend.disclaimer: 以下取宋叶梦得《避暑录话》所载送鱼误会一事，以及蔡东藩《宋史演义》第四十一回“奉使命率军征交趾 蒙慈恩减罪谪黄州”的敷演。送鱼之事为宋人笔记，未见于正史。
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.legend.intro: 饭盒打开，里面躺着一条鲊鱼。约好的暗号，只有父子二人知道。
strings.scene.beisong.wutai.end.legend: 鱼是一场误会，诗却真的写下了。神宗读到这两首诗，据说更动了恻隐之心。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 宋元丰二年（1079 年七月至十二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1079 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

characters.name: 苏轼

characters.en: Su Shi (苏轼) — scholar, Beisong; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 元丰二年，苏轼由徐州调任湖州。他在谢上表里发了几句牢骚，又有不少诗文讽刺新法。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：苏轼｜动作：湖州府衙，差官带着两名台卒闯了进来｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：片名「乌台诗案」竖排书法与朱印「东坡」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元丰二年，苏轼由徐州调任湖州。他在谢上表里发了几句牢骚，又有不少诗文讽刺新法。」

shots.vo: 御史中丞李定、监察御史舒亶、何正臣摘出他的表语和诗句，弹劾他讥讽朝政。七月，台卒到湖州把他押解进京。

shots.en: Shot 2 (10–22 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: river, boat | Action: An official boat goes north up the canal under pale moonlight by Lake Tai | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「御史中丞李定、监察御史舒亶、何正臣摘出他的表语和诗句，弹劾他讥讽朝政。七月，台卒到湖州把他押解进京。」

shots.vo: 御史台院中多柏树，常有乌鸦栖息，所以被称作乌台。苏轼在这里被关了一百多天，反复审讯。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（22–33 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：苏轼、盾墙｜动作：御史台的牢房，柏树上乌鸦成群｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：乌鸦｜屏幕文字：引文「是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「御史台院中多柏树，常有乌鸦栖息，所以被称作乌台。苏轼在这里被关了一百多天，反复审讯。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (22–33 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Su Shi, shield wall | Action: Censorate cells, crows crowding the cypress trees | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: crows | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「御史台院中多柏树，常有乌鸦栖息，所以被称作乌台。苏轼在这里被关了一百多天，反复审讯。」

shots.vo: 据宋人笔记，苏轼与长子苏迈约定，平时送饭只送菜和肉，若有不测，就送鱼。一天苏迈出外借钱，托亲戚代送，亲戚不知约定，送去了一条鱼。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（33–48 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：苏迈、苏轼｜动作：儿子送来的饭盒里，躺着一条鱼｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「据宋人笔记，苏轼与长子苏迈约定，平时送饭只送菜和肉，若有不测，就送鱼。一天苏迈出外借钱，托亲戚代送，亲戚不知约定，送去了一条鱼。」

shots.vo: 苏轼大惊，以为必死，在狱中写下两首诗寄给弟弟苏辙——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（48–55 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：苏轼；飞白题字「黄州」｜动作：狱中，他写下给弟弟的诀别诗｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：城门闭合｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「苏轼大惊，以为必死，在狱中写下两首诗寄给弟弟苏辙——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (48–55 s, 7 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: Su Shi; dry-brush calligraphy 「黄州」 | Action: In prison he writes farewell poems to his brother | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: gate slamming shut | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「苏轼大惊，以为必死，在狱中写下两首诗寄给弟弟苏辙——」

shots.vo: 神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（55–69 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：苏轼｜动作：正史结局：神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (55–69 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Su Shi | Action: Canonical outcome: Pardoned with help from the dowager and ministers, Su Shi is banished to Huangzhou, where he farms the eastern slope and calls himself Dongpo. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。」

shots.vo: 是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（69–75 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。」，下署《予以事系御史台狱狱吏稍见侵自度不能堪死狱中不得一别子由故作二诗授狱卒梁成以遗子由二首·宋苏轼撰》；右下角朱印「东坡」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。」

narration: 元丰二年，苏轼由徐州调任湖州。他在谢上表里发了几句牢骚，又有不少诗文讽刺新法。
御史中丞李定、监察御史舒亶、何正臣摘出他的表语和诗句，弹劾他讥讽朝政。七月，台卒到湖州把他押解进京。
御史台院中多柏树，常有乌鸦栖息，所以被称作乌台。苏轼在这里被关了一百多天，反复审讯。
据宋人笔记，苏轼与长子苏迈约定，平时送饭只送菜和肉，若有不测，就送鱼。一天苏迈出外借钱，托亲戚代送，亲戚不知约定，送去了一条鱼。
苏轼大惊，以为必死，在狱中写下两首诗寄给弟弟苏辙——
神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。
是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。

【水墨视频生成提示词】北宋 · 乌台诗案（苏轼）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 75 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：北宋 · 宋元丰二年（1079 年七月至十二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。

人物：

- 苏迈（北宋·苏轼长子）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；狱中为父送饭
- 苏辙（北宋·苏轼之弟）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；上书乞以己官赎兄罪，坐贬
- 李定（北宋·御史中丞）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与舒亶、何正臣弹劾苏轼
- 赵顼（北宋·宋神宗）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；独怜苏轼，从轻发落

镜头 6（55–69 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：苏轼｜动作：正史结局：神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「神宗本无杀意，加上太皇太后曹氏病中为苏轼说情，又有许多大臣营救。十二月，苏轼责授黄州团练副使，本州安置。苏辙等也受到牵连。」
镜头 7（69–75 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。」，下署《予以事系御史台狱狱吏稍见侵自度不能堪死狱中不得一别子由故作二诗授狱卒梁成以遗子由二首·宋苏轼撰》；右下角朱印「东坡」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。」

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · The Crow Terrace Poetry Case: Su Shi (「乌台诗案」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 75 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1079 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Su Shi (苏轼) — scholar, Beisong; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Su Mai (苏迈) — commoner, Beisong; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Su Zhe (苏辙) — minister, Beisong; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Ding (李定) — minister, Beisong; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhao Xu (赵顼) — ruler, Beisong; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: Su Shi | Action: An envoy bursts into the Huzhou office with two guards | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「乌台诗案」 with vermilion seal 「东坡」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元丰二年，苏轼由徐州调任湖州。他在谢上表里发了几句牢骚，又有不少诗文讽刺新法。」

strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.title: 臣之精力
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.subtitle: 司马光与资治通鉴
strings.vo.01: 宋神宗用王安石变法，司马光极力反对，两人原是好友，却从此分道扬镳。熙宁四年，司马光离开朝廷，退居洛阳。
strings.vo.02: 他在洛阳建了一座独乐园，在园中专心编写一部从战国到五代的通史。这部书在英宗时就已开局，神宗赐名《资治通鉴》，意思是有鉴于往事，以资于治道。
strings.vo.03: 刘恕、刘攽、范祖禹等人分段搜集史料，编成长编，司马光再逐条删削，定为正文。
strings.vo.04: 留下来的草稿，每一页都是工整的楷书，没有一个潦草的字。
strings.vo.05: 元丰七年，全书完成，共二百九十四卷。司马光在进书表里写道——
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.quote: 臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.fork.prompt: 臣之精力——依《宋史》直书，还是听铭记《司马温公布衾铭记》？
strings.anchor.luoyang: 司马光反对新法，退居洛阳，专心修书
strings.anchor.yuanyou: 司马光入相，尽废新法，同年病卒
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.canon.intro: 一个人反对皇帝的变法，离开了朝廷。他在洛阳的一座园子里待了十五年，写了一部一千三百多年的历史。
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.end.canon: 书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。几个月后，司马光也死在相位上。
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.pick.legend: 铭记 · 司马温公布衾铭记
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.legend.disclaime: 以下取范祖禹《司马温公布衾铭记》等宋人所记：说司马光用一段圆木做枕头，睡熟了一翻身，枕头滚开，人就醒了，起来继续读书，称为警枕。属门人追记，用以表彰师德。
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.legend.intro: 范祖禹说，老师书房里的枕头，是一段圆圆的木头。
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.end.legend: 司马光死后，入殓时身上盖的只是一床粗布被子，上面写着朋友赠他的铭文。门人们说，他一生俭朴，大抵如此。
strings.scene.beisong.simaguang.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若司马光不入相（未开放）

背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：2×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触。
第 2 行：3. 水流笔迹；4. 墨滴下坠。
排版参考尺寸：1024×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 宋神宗元丰七年（1084 年十二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1084 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

characters.name: 司马光
characters.zh: 司马光（宋·端明殿学士，判西京御史台）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；主编《资治通鉴》，后入相废新法
characters.en: Sima Guang (司马光) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 宋神宗用王安石变法，司马光极力反对，两人原是好友，却从此分道扬镳。熙宁四年，司马光离开朝廷，退居洛阳。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马光、王安石｜动作：朝堂上，两位老朋友为了新法争得面红耳赤，最后一个离开了京城｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「臣之精力」竖排书法与朱印「通鉴」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋神宗用王安石变法，司马光极力反对，两人原是好友，却从此分道扬镳。熙宁四年，司马光离开朝廷，退居洛阳。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Guang, Wang Anshi | Action: At court two old friends quarrel bitterly over the new laws, and one leaves the capital | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「臣之精力」 with vermilion seal 「通鉴」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋神宗用王安石变法，司马光极力反对，两人原是好友，却从此分道扬镳。熙宁四年，司马光离开朝廷，退居洛阳。」

shots.vo: 他在洛阳建了一座独乐园，在园中专心编写一部从战国到五代的通史。这部书在英宗时就已开局，神宗赐名《资治通鉴》，意思是有鉴于往事，以资于治道。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（12–28 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：月；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马光、竹｜动作：洛阳的独乐园里，竹林和药圃中间，一间书屋的灯整夜不灭｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；竹叶撇笔，风中摇动；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；竹简断裂、墨迹飞溅｜声音：环境：低风；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他在洛阳建了一座独乐园，在园中专心编写一部从战国到五代的通史。这部书在英宗时就已开局，神宗赐名《资治通鉴》，意思是有鉴于往事，以资于治道。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (12–28 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Guang, bamboo | Action: In the Garden of Solitary Delight in Luoyang a study lamp burns all night between bamboo and herb beds | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; flicked bamboo leaves swaying; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; bamboo slips snapping with ink spatter | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他在洛阳建了一座独乐园，在园中专心编写一部从战国到五代的通史。这部书在英宗时就已开局，神宗赐名《资治通鉴》，意思是有鉴于往事，以资于治道。」

shots.vo: 刘恕、刘攽、范祖禹等人分段搜集史料，编成长编，司马光再逐条删削，定为正文。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（28–37 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：刘恕、范祖禹｜动作：编修官们把一千多年的史事做成长编，草稿一摞摞堆满了屋子｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘恕、刘攽、范祖禹等人分段搜集史料，编成长编，司马光再逐条删削，定为正文。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (28–37 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Liu Shu, Fan Zuyu | Action: The compilers turn thirteen centuries of events into long drafts, the manuscripts piling up across the rooms | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘恕、刘攽、范祖禹等人分段搜集史料，编成长编，司马光再逐条删削，定为正文。」

shots.vo: 留下来的草稿，每一页都是工整的楷书，没有一个潦草的字。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（37–45 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：司马光｜动作：他在一张草稿上改了又改，字迹工整，没有一个草书｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「留下来的草稿，每一页都是工整的楷书，没有一个潦草的字。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (37–45 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Sima Guang | Action: He revises a draft again and again in neat script without a single cursive stroke | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「留下来的草稿，每一页都是工整的楷书，没有一个潦草的字。」

shots.vo: 元丰七年，全书完成，共二百九十四卷。司马光在进书表里写道——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（45–53 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：司马光、范祖禹；飞白题字「通鉴」｜动作：十九年后，二百九十四卷书送进了宫里｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元丰七年，全书完成，共二百九十四卷。司马光在进书表里写道——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (45–53 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Sima Guang, Fan Zuyu; dry-brush calligraphy 「通鉴」 | Action: Nineteen years on, 294 scrolls are delivered to the palace | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元丰七年，全书完成，共二百九十四卷。司马光在进书表里写道——」

shots.vo: 书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（53–69 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：司马光、范祖禹｜动作：正史结局：书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (53–69 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Sima Guang, Fan Zuyu | Action: Canonical outcome: Shenzong dies the next year; Sima Guang becomes chief minister and abolishes nearly all the new laws, Wang Anshi sighs "even this too?" and dies, and Sima dies in office a few months later. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。」

shots.vo: 臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（69–75 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」，下署《进资治通鉴表·宋司马光撰》；右下角朱印「通鉴」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (69–75 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」 signed 《进资治通鉴表·宋司马光撰》; vermilion seal 「通鉴」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：宫殿回响、低风、寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲、静默、笔落；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, low wind, quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk, silence, brush dropped; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 宋神宗用王安石变法，司马光极力反对，两人原是好友，却从此分道扬镳。熙宁四年，司马光离开朝廷，退居洛阳。
他在洛阳建了一座独乐园，在园中专心编写一部从战国到五代的通史。这部书在英宗时就已开局，神宗赐名《资治通鉴》，意思是有鉴于往事，以资于治道。
刘恕、刘攽、范祖禹等人分段搜集史料，编成长编，司马光再逐条删削，定为正文。
留下来的草稿，每一页都是工整的楷书，没有一个潦草的字。
元丰七年，全书完成，共二百九十四卷。司马光在进书表里写道——
书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。
臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】北宋 · 臣之精力（司马光与资治通鉴）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 75 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：北宋 · 宋神宗元丰七年（1084 年十二月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。

人物：
- 司马光（宋·端明殿学士，判西京御史台）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；主编《资治通鉴》，后入相废新法
- 刘恕（宋·编修官）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；分修魏晋南北朝与五代长编
- 范祖禹（宋·编修官）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；分修唐代长编
- 王安石（宋·前宰相）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；新法主持者，与司马光政见相左
- 刘攽（宋·编修官）：展脚幞头，圆领大袖公服，褙子；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；分修两汉长编

分镜：
镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马光、王安石｜动作：朝堂上，两位老朋友为了新法争得面红耳赤，最后一个离开了京城｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「臣之精力」竖排书法与朱印「通鉴」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋神宗用王安石变法，司马光极力反对，两人原是好友，却从此分道扬镳。熙宁四年，司马光离开朝廷，退居洛阳。」

镜头 3（28–37 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：刘恕、范祖禹｜动作：编修官们把一千多年的史事做成长编，草稿一摞摞堆满了屋子｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘恕、刘攽、范祖禹等人分段搜集史料，编成长编，司马光再逐条删削，定为正文。」
镜头 4（37–45 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：司马光｜动作：他在一张草稿上改了又改，字迹工整，没有一个草书｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「留下来的草稿，每一页都是工整的楷书，没有一个潦草的字。」
镜头 5（45–53 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：司马光、范祖禹；飞白题字「通鉴」｜动作：十九年后，二百九十四卷书送进了宫里｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元丰七年，全书完成，共二百九十四卷。司马光在进书表里写道——」
镜头 6（53–69 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：司马光、范祖禹｜动作：正史结局：书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「书成后第二年，神宗驾崩。司马光被召入朝，拜为宰相，几个月内把新法几乎全部废除。王安石在江宁听说免役法也被废了，叹道：亦罢至此乎！不久病死。」
镜头 7（69–75 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」，下署《进资治通鉴表·宋司马光撰》；右下角朱印「通鉴」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「臣今骸骨癯瘁，目视昏近，齿牙无几，神识衰耗……臣之精力，尽于此书。」

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern Song (960–1127) · My Strength Is Spent: Sima Guang and the Comprehensive Mirror (「臣之精力」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 75 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern Song (960–1127), 1084 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.

Characters:
- Sima Guang (司马光) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Shu (刘恕) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Fan Zuyu (范祖禹) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Anshi (王安石) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Ban (刘攽) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, wide-sleeved round-collar official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:

strings.scene.beisong.fangla.title: 帮源洞
strings.scene.beisong.fangla.subtitle: 方腊与宋江
strings.vo.01: 徽宗喜好奇石，朱勔在东南搜刮花石，民怨沸腾。宣和二年十月，青溪漆园主方腊起事。
strings.vo.02: 一个多月里，睦、歙、杭等州相继陷落。朝廷急调本拟北伐的童贯禁军南下。
strings.vo.03: 同时，宋江一伙转掠京东、淮南。宣和三年二月，知海州张叔夜设伏焚其舟船，宋江投降。
strings.vo.04: 四月，方腊退入帮源洞。洞窟深险，官军不知入口。偏将韩世忠沿溪潜行，向山中妇人问得小路。
strings.scene.beisong.fangla.fork.prompt: 帮源洞——依《宋史》直书，还是听小说《水浒传》？
strings.scene.beisong.fangla.canon.intro: 宣和三年四月，帮源洞外的山谷里驻满了官军。洞有几个出口，没有人说得清。韩世忠带着几个人，沿溪水往山里走。
strings.scene.beisong.fangla.end.canon: 韩世忠格杀数十人，生擒方腊。出洞时辛兴宗领兵截住洞口，夺去其功。方腊被押往汴京，八月伏诛。宋江是否随军征讨方腊，宋代史料说法不一。
strings.scene.beisong.fangla.legend.disclaimer: 以下取明代小说《水浒传》中梁山好汉受招安、征方腊的情节，并参照蔡东藩《宋史演义》第五十五至五十七回。正史关于宋江只有寥寥数语；小说中的一百零八将及征方腊诸战多为虚构，蔡东藩亦指出武松擒方腊之说为讹传。
strings.scene.beisong.fangla.legend.intro: 小说里，梁山泊一百零八人受了招安，奉诏南征方腊。一路攻城夺寨，兄弟死伤大半。
strings.scene.beisong.fangla.end.legend: 小说里的梁山兄弟和正史里的韩世忠，走到了同一个洞口。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 北宋 · 宣和三年四月（1121 年四月）。汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。
setting.en: Northern Song (960–1127), 1121 CE — Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.
